1.zh: 以色列的众子，各带家眷，和雅各一同来到埃及。他们的名字记在下面。
1.en: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:

1.zh: 有流便 、 西缅 、 利未 、 犹大 、
1.en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;

1.zh: 以萨迦 、 西布伦 、 便雅悯 、
1.en: Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin;

1.zh: 但 、 拿弗他利 、 迦得 、 亚设。
1.en: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.

1.zh: 凡从雅各而生的，共有七十人。约瑟已经在埃及。
1.en: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all; Joseph was already in Egypt.

1.zh: 约瑟和他的弟兄，并那一代的人，都死了。
1.en: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,

1.zh: 以色列人生养众多，并且繁茂，极其强盛，满了那地。
1.en: but the Israelites were fruitful and multiplied greatly and became exceedingly numerous, so that the land was filled with them.

1.zh: 有不认识约瑟的新王起来，治理埃及，
1.en: Then a new king, who did not know about Joseph, came to power in Egypt.

1.zh: 对他的百姓说：看哪，这以色列民比我们还多，又比我们强盛。
1.en: "Look," he said to his people, "the Israelites have become much too numerous for us.

1.zh: 来罢，我们不如用巧计待他们，恐怕他们多起来，日后若遇甚么争战的事，就连合我们的仇敌攻击我们，离开这地去了。
1.en: Come, we must deal shrewdly with them or they will become even more numerous and, if war breaks out, will join our enemies, fight against us and leave the country."

1.zh: 于是埃及人派督工的辖制他们，加重担苦害他们。他们为法老建造两座积货城，就是比东和兰塞。
1.en: So they put slave masters over them to oppress them with forced labor, and they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.

1.zh: 只是越发苦害他们，他们越发多起来，越发蔓延；埃及人就因以色列人愁烦。
1.en: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites

1.zh: 埃及人严严的使以色列人做工，
1.en: and worked them ruthlessly.

1.zh: 使他们因做苦工觉得命苦；无论是和泥，是作砖，是作田间各样的工，在一切的工上都严严的待他们。
1.en: They made their lives bitter with hard labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields; in all their hard labor the Egyptians used them ruthlessly.

1.zh: 有希伯来的两个收生婆，一名施弗拉，一名普阿；埃及王对他们说：
1.en: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,

1.zh: 你们为希伯来妇人收生，看他们临盆的时候，若是男孩，就把他杀了；若是女孩，就留他存活。
1.en: "When you help the Hebrew women in childbirth and observe them on the delivery stool, if it is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, let her live."

1.zh: 但是收生婆敬畏神，不照埃及王的吩咐行，竟存留男孩的性命。
1.en: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do what the king of Egypt had told them to do; they let the boys live.

1.zh: 埃及王召了收生婆来，说：你们为甚么做这事，存留男孩的性命呢？
1.en: Then the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, "Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?"

1.zh: 收生婆对法老说：因为希伯来妇人与埃及妇人不同；希伯来妇人本是健壮的（原文作活泼的），收生婆还没有到，他们已经生产了。
1.en: The midwives answered Pharaoh, "Hebrew women are not like Egyptian women; they are vigorous and give birth before the midwives arrive."

1.zh: 神厚待收生婆。以色列人多起来，极其强盛。
1.en: So God was kind to the midwives and the people increased and became even more numerous.

1.zh: 收生婆因为敬畏神，神便叫他们成立家室。
1.en: And because the midwives feared God, he gave them families of their own.

1.zh: 法老吩咐他的众民说：以色列人所生的男孩，你们都要丢在河里；一切的女孩，你们要存留他的性命。
1.en: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Every boy that is born you must throw into the Nile, but let every girl live."

2.zh: 有一个利未家的人娶了一个利未女子为妻。
2.en: Now a man of the house of Levimarried a Levite woman,

2.zh: 那女人怀孕，生一个儿子，见他俊美，就藏了他三个月，
2.en: There the angel of the Lord appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.

2.zh: 后来不能再藏，就取了一个蒲草箱，抹上石漆和石油，将孩子放在里头，把箱子搁在河边的芦荻中。
2.en: So Moses thought, "I will go over and see this strange sight-why the bush does not burn up."

2.zh: 孩子的姊姊远远站著，要知道他究竟怎么样。
2.en: When the Lord saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."

2.zh: 法老的女儿来到河边洗澡，他的使女们在河边行走。他看见箱子在芦荻中，就打发一个婢女拿来。
2.en: "Do not come any closer," God said. "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground."

2.zh: 他打开箱子，看见那孩子。孩子哭了，他就可怜他，说：“这是希伯来人的一个孩子。”
2.en: Then he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob." At this, Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.

2.zh: 孩子的姊姊对法老的女儿说：“我去在希伯来妇人中叫一个奶妈来，为你奶这孩子，可以不可以？”
2.en: The Lord said, "I have indeed seen the misery of my people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their slave drivers, and I am concerned about their suffering.

2.zh: 法老的女儿说：“可以。”童女就去叫了孩子的母亲来。
2.en: So I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land into a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey-the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

2.zh: 法老的女儿对他说：“你把这孩子抱去，为我奶他，我必给你工价。”妇人就抱了孩子去奶他。
2.en: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached me, and I have seen the way the Egyptians are oppressing them.

2.zh: 孩子渐长，妇人把他带到法老的女儿那里，就作了他的儿子。他给孩子起名叫摩西，意思说：因我把他从水里拉出来。
2.en: So now, go. I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring my people the Israelites out of Egypt."

2.zh: 后来，摩西长大，他出去到他弟兄那里，看他们的重担，见一个埃及人打希伯来人的一个弟兄。
2.en: But Moses said to God, "Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?"

2.zh: 他左右观看，见没有人，就把埃及人打死了，藏在沙土里。
2.en: And God said, "I will be with you. And this will be the sign to you that it is I who have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God on this mountain."

2.zh: 第二天他出去，见有两个希伯来人争斗，就对那欺负人的说：“你为甚么打你同族的人呢？”
2.en: Moses said to God, "Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you,' and they ask me, 'What is his name?' Then what shall I tell them?"

2.zh: 那人说：“谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？难道你要杀我，像杀那埃及人么？”摩西便惧怕，说：“这事必是被人知道了。”
2.en: God said to Moses, "I am who I am . This is what you are to say to the Israelites: 'IAM has sent me to you.' "

2.zh: 法老听见这事，就想杀摩西，但摩西躲避法老，逃往米甸地居住。
2.en: God also said to Moses, "Say to the Israelites, 'The Lord , the God of your fathers-the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob-has sent me to you.' This is my name forever, the name by which I am to be remembered from generation to generation.

2.zh: 一日，他在井旁坐下。米甸的祭司有七个女儿；他们来打水，打满了槽，要饮父亲的群羊。
2.en: "Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, 'The Lord , the God of your fathers-the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob-appeared to me and said: I have watched over you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.

2.zh: 有牧羊的人来，把他们赶走了，摩西却起来帮助他们，又饮了他们的群羊。
2.en: And I have promised to bring you up out of your misery in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites-a land flowing with milk and honey.'

2.zh: 他们来到父亲流珥那里；他说：“今日你们为何来得这么快呢？”
2.en: "The elders of Israel will listen to you. Then you and the elders are to go to the king of Egypt and say to him, 'The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Let us take a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God.'

2.zh: 他们说：“有一个埃及人救我们脱离牧羊人的手，并且为我们打水饮了群羊。”
2.en: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand compels him.

2.zh: 他对女儿们说：“那个人在那里？你们为甚么撇下他呢？你们去请他来吃饭。”
2.en: So I will stretch out my hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders that I will perform among them. After that, he will let you go.

2.zh: 摩西甘心和那人同住；那人把他的女儿西坡拉给摩西为妻。
2.en: "And I will make the Egyptians favorably disposed toward this people, so that when you leave you will not go empty-handed.

2.zh: 西坡拉生了一个儿子，摩西给他起名叫革舜，意思说：“因我在外邦作了寄居的。”
2.en: Every woman is to ask her neighbor and any woman living in her house for articles of silver and gold and for clothing, which you will put on your sons and daughters. And so you will plunder the Egyptians."

2.zh: 过了多年，埃及王死了。以色列人因做苦工，就叹息哀求，他们的哀声达于神。
2.en: During that long period, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned in their slavery and cried out, and their cry for help because of their slavery went up to God.

2.zh: 神听见他们的哀声，就记念他与亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各所立的约。
2.en: God heard their groaning and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.

2.zh: 神看顾以色列人，也知道他们的苦情。
2.en: So God looked on the Israelites and was concerned about them. 3Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the desert and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.

3.zh: 摩西牧养他岳父米甸祭司叶忒罗的羊群；一日领羊群往野外去，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
耶和华的使者从荆棘里火焰中向摩西显现。摩西观看，不料，荆棘被火烧著，却没有烧毁。
摩西说：我要过去看这大异象，这荆棘为何没有烧坏呢？
耶和华神见他过去要看，就从荆棘里呼叫说：摩西！摩西！他说：我在这里。
神说：不要近前来。当把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地；
又说：我是你父亲的神，是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神。摩西蒙上脸，因为怕看神。
耶和华说：我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了；他们因受督工的辖制所发的哀声，我也听见了。我原知道他们的痛苦，
我下来是要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们出了那地，到美好 、 宽阔 、 流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人 、 赫人 、 亚摩利人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人之地。
现在以色列人的哀声达到我耳中，我也看见埃及人怎样欺压他们。
故此，我要打发你去见法老，使你可以将我的百姓以色列人从埃及领出来。
摩西对神说：我是甚么人，竟能去见法老，将以色列人从埃及领出来呢？
神说：我必与你同在。你将百姓从埃及领出来之后，你们必在这山上事奉我；这就是我打发你去的证据。
摩西对神说：我到以色列人那里，对他们说：你们祖宗的神打发我到你们这里来。他们若问我说：他叫甚么名字？我要对他们说甚么呢？
神对摩西说：我是自有永有的；又说：你要对以色列人这样说：那自有的打发我到你们这里来。
神又对摩西说：你要对以色列人这样说：耶和华 ─ 你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，打发我到你们这里来。耶和华是我的名，直到永远；这也是我的纪念，直到万代。
你去招聚以色列的长老，对他们说：耶和华你们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，向我显现，说：我实在眷顾了你们，我也看见埃及人怎样待你们。
我也说：要将你们从埃及的困苦中领出来，往迦南人 、 赫人 、 亚摩利人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人的地去，就是到流奶与蜜之地。
他们必听你的话。你和以色列的长老要去见埃及王，对他说：耶和华希伯来人的神遇见了我们，现在求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，为要祭祀耶和华我们的神。
我知道虽用大能的手，埃及王也不容你们去。
我必伸手在埃及中间施行我一切的奇事，攻击那地，然后他才容你们去。
我必叫你们在埃及人眼前蒙恩，你们去的时候就不至于空手而去。
但各妇女必向他的邻舍，并居住在他家里的女人，要金器银器和衣裳，好给你们的儿女穿戴。这样你们就把埃及人的财物夺去了。

4.zh: 摩西回答说：他们必不信我，也不听我的话，必说：耶和华并没有向你显现。
4.en: Moses answered, "What if they do not believe me or listen to me and say, 'The Lord did not appear to you'?"

4.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你手里是甚么？他说：是杖。
4.en: Then the Lord said to him, "What is that in your hand?" "A staff," he replied.

4.zh: 耶和华说：丢在地上。他一丢下去，就变作蛇；摩西便跑开。
4.en: The Lord said, "Throw it on the ground." Moses threw it on the ground and it became a snake, and he ran from it.

4.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：伸出手来，拿住他的尾巴，他必在你手中仍变为杖；
4.en: Then the Lord said to him, "Reach out your hand and take it by the tail." So Moses reached out and took hold of the snake and it turned back into a staff in his hand.

4.zh: 如此好叫他们信耶和华 ─ 他们祖宗的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒的神，雅各的神，是向你显现了。
4.en: "This," said the Lord , "is so that they may believe that the Lord , the God of their fathers-the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob-has appeared to you."

4.zh: 耶和华又对他说：把手放在怀里。他就把手放在怀里，及至抽出来，不料，手长了大痳疯，有雪那样白。
4.en: Then the Lord said, "Put your hand inside your cloak." So Moses put his hand into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was leprous, like snow.

4.zh: 耶和华说：再把手放在怀里。他就再把手放在怀里，及至从怀里抽出来，不料，手已经复原，与周身的肉一样；
4.en: "Now put it back into your cloak," he said. So Moses put his hand back into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his flesh.

4.zh: 又说：倘或他们不听你的话，也不信头一个神迹，他们必信第二个神迹。
4.en: Then the Lord said, "If they do not believe you or pay attention to the first miraculous sign, they may believe the second.

4.zh: 这两个神迹若都不信，也不听你的话，你就从河里取些水，倒在旱地上，你从河里取的水必在旱地上变作血。
4.en: But if they do not believe these two signs or listen to you, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. The water you take from the river will become blood on the ground."

4.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：主阿，我素日不是能言的人，就是从你对仆人说话以后，也是这样。我本是拙口笨舌的。
4.en: Moses said to the Lord , "O Lord, I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since you have spoken to your servant. I am slow of speech and tongue."

4.zh: 耶和华对他说：谁造人的口呢？谁使人口哑 、 耳聋 、 目明 、 眼瞎呢？岂不是我 ─ 耶和华么？
4.en: The Lord said to him, "Who gave man his mouth? Who makes him deaf or mute? Who gives him sight or makes him blind? Is it not I, the Lord ?

4.zh: 现在去罢，我必赐你口才，指教你所当说的话。
4.en: Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."

4.zh: 摩西说：主阿，你愿意打发谁，就打发谁去罢！
4.en: But Moses said, "O Lord, please send someone else to do it."

4.zh: 耶和华向摩西发怒说：不是有你的哥哥利未人亚伦么？我知道他是能言的；现在他出来迎接你，他一见你，心里就欢喜。
4.en: Then the Lord 's anger burned against Moses and he said, "What about your brother, Aaron the Levite? I know he can speak well. He is already on his way to meet you, and his heart will be glad when he sees you.

4.zh: 你要将当说的话传给他；我也要赐你和他口才，又要指教你们所当行的事。
4.en: You shall speak to him and put words in his mouth; I will help both of you speak and will teach you what to do.

4.zh: 他要替你对百姓说话；你要以他当作口，他要以你当作神。
4.en: He will speak to the people for you, and it will be as if he were your mouth and as if you were God to him.

4.zh: 你手里要拿这杖，好行神迹。
4.en: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform miraculous signs with it."

4.zh: 于是，摩西回到他岳父叶忒罗那里，对他说：求你容我回去见我在埃及的弟兄，看他们还在不在。叶忒罗对摩西说：你可以平平安安地去罢！
4.en: Then Moses went back to Jethro his father-in-law and said to him, "Let me go back to my own people in Egypt to see if any of them are still alive." Jethro said, "Go, and I wish you well."

4.zh: 耶和华在米甸对摩西说：你要回埃及去，因为寻索你命的人都死了。
4.en: Now the Lord had said to Moses in Midian, "Go back to Egypt, for all the men who wanted to kill you are dead."

4.zh: 摩西就带著妻子和两个儿子，叫他们骑上驴，回埃及地去。摩西手里拿著神的杖。
4.en: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey and started back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.

4.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你回到埃及的时候，要留意将我指示你的一切奇事行在法老面前。但我要使（或作：任凭；下同）他的心刚硬，他必不容百姓去。
4.en: The Lord said to Moses, "When you return to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders I have given you the power to do. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.

4.zh: 你要对法老说：耶和华这样说：以色列是我的儿子，我的长子。
4.en: Then say to Pharaoh, 'This is what the Lord says: Israel is my firstborn son,

4.zh: 我对你说过：容我的儿子去，好事奉我。你还是不肯容他去。看哪，我要杀你的长子。
4.en: and I told you, "Let my son go, so he may worship me." But you refused to let him go; so I will kill your firstborn son.' "

4.zh: 摩西在路上住宿的地方，耶和华遇见他，想要杀他。
4.en: At a lodging place on the way, the Lord met [Moses] and was about to kill him.

4.zh: 西坡拉就拿一块火石，割下他儿子的阳皮，丢在摩西脚前，说：你真是我的血郎了。
4.en: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son's foreskin and touched [Moses'] feet with it. "Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me," she said

4.zh: 这样，耶和华才放了他。西坡拉说：你因割礼就是血郎了。
4.en: So the Lord let him alone. (At that time she said "bridegroom of blood," referring to circumcision.)

4.zh: 耶和华对亚伦说：你往旷野去迎接摩西。他就去，在神的山遇见摩西，和他亲嘴。
4.en: The Lord said to Aaron, "Go into the desert to meet Moses." So he met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.

4.zh: 摩西将耶和华打发他所说的言语和嘱咐他所行的神迹都告诉了亚伦。
4.en: Then Moses told Aaron everything the Lord had sent him to say, and also about all the miraculous signs he had commanded him to perform.

4.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦就去招聚以色列的众长老。
4.en: Moses and Aaron brought together all the elders of the Israelites,

4.zh: 亚伦将耶和华对摩西所说的一切话述说了一遍，又在百姓眼前行了那些神迹，
4.en: and Aaron told them everything the Lord had said to Moses. He also performed the signs before the people,

4.zh: 百姓就信了。以色列人听见耶和华眷顾他们，鉴察他们的困苦，就低头下拜。
4.en: and they believed. And when they heard that the Lord was concerned about them and had seen their misery, they bowed down and worshiped.

5.zh: 后来摩西 、 亚伦去对法老说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神这样说：容我的百姓去，在旷野向我守节。
5.en: Afterward Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: 'Let my people go, so that they may hold a festival to me in the desert.' "

5.zh: 法老说：耶和华是谁，使我听他的话，容以色列人去呢？我不认识耶和华，也不容以色列人去！
5.en: Pharaoh said, "Who is the Lord , that I should obey him and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord and I will not let Israel go."

5.zh: 他们说：希伯来人的神遇见了我们。求你容我们往旷野去，走三天的路程，祭祀耶和华 ─ 我们的神，免得他用瘟疫 、 刀兵攻击我们。
5.en: Then they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Now let us take a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, or he may strike us with plagues or with the sword."

5.zh: 埃及王对他们说：摩西 、 亚伦！你们为甚么叫百姓旷工呢？你们去担你们的担子罢！
5.en: But the king of Egypt said, "Moses and Aaron, why are you taking the people away from their labor? Get back to your work!"

5.zh: 又说：看哪，这地的以色列人如今众多，你们竟叫他们歇下担子！
5.en: Then Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you are stopping them from working."

5.zh: 当天，法老吩咐督工的和官长说：
5.en: That same day Pharaoh gave this order to the slave drivers and foremen in charge of the people:

5.zh: 你们不可照常把草给百姓做砖，叫他们自己去捡草。
5.en: "You are no longer to supply the people with straw for making bricks; let them go and gather their own straw.

5.zh: 他们素常做砖的数目，你们仍旧向他们要，一点不可减少；因为他们是懒惰的，所以呼求说：容我们去祭祀我们的神。
5.en: But require them to make the same number of bricks as before; don't reduce the quota. They are lazy; that is why they are crying out, 'Let us go and sacrifice to our God.'

5.zh: 你们要把更重的工夫加在这些人身上，叫他们劳碌，不听虚谎的言语。
5.en: Make the work harder for the men so that they keep working and pay no attention to lies."

5.zh: 督工的和官长出来对百姓说：法老这样说：我不给你们草。
5.en: Then the slave drivers and the foremen went out and said to the people, "This is what Pharaoh says: 'I will not give you any more straw.

5.zh: 你们自己在那里能找草，就往那里去找罢！但你们的工一点不可减少。
5.en: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it, but your work will not be reduced at all.' "

5.zh: 于是百姓散在埃及遍地，捡碎秸当作草。
5.en: So the people scattered all over Egypt to gather stubble to use for straw.

5.zh: 督工的催著说：你们一天当完一天的工，与先前有草一样。
5.en: The slave drivers kept pressing them, saying, "Complete the work required of you for each day, just as when you had straw."

5.zh: 法老督工的，责打他所派以色列人的官长，说：你们昨天今天为甚么没有照向来的数目做砖 、 完你们的工作呢？
5.en: The Israelite foremen appointed by Pharaoh's slave drivers were beaten and were asked, "Why didn't you meet your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as before?"

5.zh: 以色列人的官长就来哀求法老说：为甚么这样待你的仆人？
5.en: Then the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: "Why have you treated your servants this way?

5.zh: 督工的不把草给仆人，并且对我们说：做砖罢！看哪，你仆人挨了打，其实是你百姓的错。
5.en: Your servants are given no straw, yet we are told, 'Make bricks!' Your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people."

5.zh: 但法老说：你们是懒惰的！你们是懒惰的！所以说：容我们去祭祀耶和华。
5.en: Pharaoh said, "Lazy, that's what you are- lazy! That is why you keep saying, 'Let us go and sacrifice to the Lord .'

5.zh: 现在你们去做工罢！草是不给你们的，砖却要如数交纳。
5.en: Now get to work. You will not be given any straw, yet you must produce your full quota of bricks."

5.zh: 以色列人的官长听说你们每天做砖的工作一点不可减少，就知道是遭遇祸患了。
5.en: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, "You are not to reduce the number of bricks required of you for each day."

5.zh: 他们离了法老出来，正遇见摩西 、 亚伦站在对面，
5.en: When they left Pharaoh, they found Moses and Aaron waiting to meet them, <

5.zh: 就向他们说：愿耶和华鉴察你们，施行判断；因你们使我们在法老和他臣仆面前有了臭名，把刀递在他们手中杀我们。
5.en: and they said, "May the Lord look upon you and judge you! You have made us a stench to Pharaoh and his officials and have put a sword in their hand to kill us."

5.zh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说：主阿，你为甚么苦待这百姓呢？为甚么打发我去呢？
5.en: Moses returned to the Lord and said, "O Lord, why have you brought trouble upon this people? Is this why you sent me?

5.zh: 自从我去见法老，奉你的名说话，他就苦待这百姓，你一点也没有拯救他们。
5.en: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble upon this people, and you have not rescued your people at all."

6.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：现在你必看见我向法老所行的事，使他因我大能的手容以色列人去，且把他们赶出他的地。
6.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Nowyou will see what I will do to Pharaoh: Because of my mighty hand he will let them go; because of my mighty hand he will drive them out of his country."

6.zh: 神晓谕摩西说：我是耶和华。
6.en: God also said to Moses, "I am the Lord .

6.zh: 我从前向亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各显现为全能的神；至于我名耶和华，他们未曾知道。
6.en: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name the Lord I did not make myself known to them.

6.zh: 我与他们坚定所立的约，要把他们寄居的迦南地赐给他们。
6.en: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, where they lived as aliens.

6.zh: 我也听见以色列人被埃及人苦待的哀声，我也记念我的约。
6.en: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered my covenant.

6.zh: 所以你要对以色列人说：我是耶和华；我要用伸出来的膀臂重重的刑罚埃及人，救赎你们脱离他们的重担，不做他们的苦工。
6.en: "Therefore, say to the Israelites: 'I am the Lord , and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians. I will free you from being slaves to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.

6.zh: 我要以你们为我的百姓，我也要作你们的神。你们要知道我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神，是救你们脱离埃及人之重担的。
6.en: I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.

6.zh: 我起誓应许给亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各的那地，我要把你们领进去，将那地赐给你们为业。我是耶和华。
6.en: And I will bring you to the land I swore with uplifted hand to give to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the Lord .' "

6.zh: 摩西将这话告诉以色列人，只是他们因苦工愁烦，不肯听他的话。
6.en: Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and cruel bondage.

6.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
6.en: Then the Lord said to Moses,

6.zh: 你进去对埃及王法老说，要容以色列人出他的地。
6.en: "Go, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his country."

6.zh: 摩西在耶和华面前说：以色列人尚且不听我的话，法老怎肯听我这拙口笨舌的人呢？
6.en: But Moses said to the Lord , "If the Israelites will not listen to me, why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I speak with faltering lips ?"

6.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西 、 亚伦往以色列人和埃及王法老那里去，把以色列人从埃及地领出来。
6.en: Now the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron about the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he commanded them to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

6.zh: 以色列人家长的名字记在下面。以色列长子流便的儿子是哈诺 、 法路 、 希斯仑 、 迦米；这是流便的各家。
6.en: These were the heads of their families : The sons of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.

6.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利 、 雅悯 、 阿辖 、 雅斤 、 琐辖，和迦南女子的儿子扫罗；这是西缅的各家。
6.en: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.

6.zh: 利未众子的名字按著他们的后代记在下面：就是革顺 、 哥辖 、 米拉利。利未一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
6.en: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.

6.zh: 革顺的儿子按著家室是立尼 、 示每。
6.en: The sons of Gershon, by clans, were Libni and Shimei.

6.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰 、 以斯哈 、 希伯伦 、 乌薛。哥辖一生的岁数是一百三十三岁。
6.en: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.

6.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利和母示；这是利未的家，都按著他们的后代。
6.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of Levi according to their records.

6.zh: 暗兰娶了他父亲的妹妹约基别为妻，他给他生了亚伦和摩西。暗兰一生的岁数是一百三十七岁。
6.en: Amram married his father's sister Jochebed, who bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.

6.zh: 以斯哈的儿子是可拉 、 尼斐 、 细基利。
6.en: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg and Zicri.

6.zh: 乌薛的儿子是米沙利 、 以利撒反 、 西提利。
6.en: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan and Sithri.

6.zh: 亚伦娶了亚米拿达的女儿，拿顺的妹妹，以利沙巴为妻，他给他生了拿答 、 亚比户 、 以利亚撒 、 以他玛。
6.en: Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

6.zh: 可拉的儿子是亚惜 、 以利加拿 、 亚比亚撒；这是可拉的各家。
6.en: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.

6.zh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒娶了普铁的一个女儿为妻，他给他生了非尼哈。这是利未人的家长，都按著他们的家。
6.en: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families, clan by clan.

6.zh: 耶和华说：将以色列人按著他们的军队从埃及地领出来。这是对那亚伦 、 摩西说的。
6.en: It was this same Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, "Bring the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions."

6.zh: 对埃及王法老说要将以色列人从埃及领出来的，就是这摩西 、 亚伦。
6.en: They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing the Israelites out of Egypt. It was the same Moses and Aaron.

6.zh: 当耶和华在埃及地对摩西说话的日子，
6.en: Now when the Lord spoke to Moses in Egypt,

6.zh: 他向摩西说：我是耶和华；我对你说的一切话，你都要告诉埃及王法老。
6.en: he said to him, "I am the Lord . Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I tell you."

6.zh: 摩西在耶和华面前说：看哪，我是拙口笨舌的人，法老怎肯听我呢？
6.en: But Moses said to the Lord , "Since I speak with faltering lips, why would Pharaoh listen to me?"

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：我使你在法老面前代替神，你的哥哥亚伦是替你说话的。
7.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.

7.zh: 凡我所吩咐你的，你都要说。你的哥哥亚伦要对法老说，容以色列人出他的地。
7.en: You are to say everything I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his country.

7.zh: 我要使法老的心刚硬，也要在埃及地多行神迹奇事。
7.en: But I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and though I multiply my miraculous signs and wonders in Egypt,

7.zh: 但法老必不听你们；我要伸手重重的刑罚埃及，将我的军队以色列民从埃及地领出来。
7.en: he will not listen to you. Then I will lay my hand on Egypt and with mighty acts of judgment I will bring out my divisions, my people the Israelites.

7.zh: 我伸手攻击埃及，将以色列人从他们中间领出来的时候，埃及人就要知道我是耶和华。
7.en: And the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out of it."

7.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦这样行；耶和华怎样吩咐他们，他们就照样行了。
7.en: Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord commanded them.

7.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦与法老说话的时候，摩西八十岁，亚伦八十三岁。
7.en: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.

7.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西 、 亚伦说：
7.en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron,

7.zh: 法老若对你们说：你们行件奇事罢！你就吩咐亚伦说：把杖丢在法老面前，使杖变作蛇。
7.en: "When Pharaoh says to you, 'Perform a miracle,' then say to Aaron, 'Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,' and it will become a snake."

7.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦进去见法老，就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦把杖丢在法老和臣仆面前，杖就变作蛇。
7.en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the Lord commanded. Aaron threw his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a snake.

7.zh: 于是法老召了博士和术士来；他们是埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。
7.en: Pharaoh then summoned wise men and sorcerers, and the Egyptian magicians also did the same things by their secret arts:

7.zh: 他们各人丢下自己的杖，杖就变作蛇；但亚伦的杖吞了他们的杖。
7.en: Each one threw down his staff and it became a snake. But Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs.

7.zh: 法老心里刚硬，不肯听从摩西 、 亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。
7.en: Yet Pharaoh's heart became hard and he would not listen to them, just as the Lord had said.

7.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：法老心里固执，不肯容百姓去。
7.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Pharaoh's heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.

7.zh: 明日早晨，他出来往水边去，你要往河边迎接他，手里要拿著那变过蛇的杖，
7.en: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as he goes out to the water. Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.

7.zh: 对他说：耶和华 ─ 希伯来人的神打发我来见你，说：容我的百姓去，好在旷野事奉我。到如今你还是不听。
7.en: Then say to him, 'The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to say to you: Let my people go, so that they may worship me in the desert. But until now you have not listened.

7.zh: 耶和华这样说：我要用我手里的杖击打河中的水，水就变作血；因此，你必知道我是耶和华。
7.en: This is what the Lord says: By this you will know that I am the Lord : With the staff that is in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will be changed into blood.

7.zh: 河里的鱼必死，河也要腥臭，埃及人就要厌恶吃这河里的水。
7.en: The fish in the Nile will die, and the river will stink; the Egyptians will not be able to drink its water.' "

7.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：你对亚伦说：把你的杖伸在埃及所有的水以上，就是在他们的江 、 河 、 池 、 塘以上，叫水都变作血。在埃及遍地，无论在木器中，石器中，都必有血。
7.en: The Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt-over the streams and canals, over the ponds and all the reservoirs'-and they will turn to blood. Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in the wooden buckets and stone jars."

7.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦就照耶和华所吩咐的行。亚伦在法老和臣仆眼前举杖击打河里的水，河里的水都变作血了。
7.en: Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord had commanded. He raised his staff in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was changed into blood.

7.zh: 河里的鱼死了，河也腥臭了，埃及人就不能吃这河里的水；埃及遍地都有了血。
7.en: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.

7.zh: 埃及行法术的，也用邪术照样而行。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西 、 亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。
7.en: But the Egyptian magicians did the same things by their secret arts, and Pharaoh's heart became hard; he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.

7.zh: 法老转身进宫，也不把这事放在心上。
7.en: Instead, he turned and went into his palace, and did not take even this to heart.

7.zh: 埃及人都在河的两边挖地，要得水喝，因为他们不能喝这河里的水。
7.en: And all the Egyptians dug along the Nile to get drinking water, because they could not drink the water of the river.

7.zh: 耶和华击打河以后满了七天。
7.en: Seven days passed after the Lord struck the Nile.

8.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：你进去见法老，对他说：耶和华这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
8.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

8.zh: 你若不肯容他们去，我必使青蛙糟蹋你的四境。
8.en: If you refuse to let them go, I will plague your whole country with frogs.

8.zh: 河里要滋生青蛙；这青蛙要上来进你的宫殿和你的卧房，上你的床榻，进你臣仆的房屋，上你百姓的身上，进你的炉灶和你的抟面盆，
8.en: The Nile will teem with frogs. They will come up into your palace and your bedroom and onto your bed, into the houses of your officials and on your people, and into your ovens and kneading troughs.

8.zh: 又要上你和你百姓并你众臣仆的身上。
8.en: The frogs will go up on you and your people and all your officials.' "

8.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：你对亚伦说：把你的杖伸在江 、 河 、 池以上，使青蛙到埃及地上来。
8.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Stretch out your hand with your staff over the streams and canals and ponds, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.' "

8.zh: 亚伦便伸杖在埃及的诸水以上，青蛙就上来，遮满了埃及地。
8.en: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.

8.zh: 行法术的也用他们的邪术照样而行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。
8.en: But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.

8.zh: 法老召了摩西 、 亚伦来，说：请你们求耶和华使这青蛙离开我和我的民，我就容百姓去祭祀耶和华。
8.en: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Pray to the Lord to take the frogs away from me and my people, and I will let your people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord ."

8.zh: 摩西对法老说：任凭你罢，我要何时为你和你的臣仆并你的百姓祈求，除灭青蛙离开你和你的宫殿只留在河里呢？
8.en: Moses said to Pharaoh, "I leave to you the honor of setting the time for me to pray for you and your officials and your people that you and your houses may be rid of the frogs, except for those that remain in the Nile."

8.zh: 他说：明天。摩西说：可以照你的话罢，好叫你知道没有像耶和华 ─ 我们神的。
8.en: "Tomorrow," Pharaoh said. Moses replied, "It will be as you say, so that you may know there is no one like the Lord our God.

8.zh: 青蛙要离开你和你的宫殿，并你的臣仆与你的百姓，只留在河里。
8.en: The frogs will leave you and your houses, your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile."

8.zh: 于是摩西 、 亚伦离开法老出去。摩西为扰害法老的青蛙呼求耶和华。
8.en: After Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the Lord about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh.

8.zh: 耶和华就照摩西的话行。凡在房里 、 院中 、 田间的青蛙都死了。
8.en: And the Lord did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, in the courtyards and in the fields.

8.zh: 众人把青蛙聚拢成堆，遍地就都腥臭。
8.en: They were piled into heaps, and the land reeked of them.

8.zh: 但法老见灾祸松缓，就硬著心，不肯听他们，正如耶和华所说的。
8.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said.

8.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：你对亚伦说：伸出你的杖击打地上的尘土，使尘土在埃及遍地变作虱子（或译：虼蚤；下同）。
8.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the ground,' and throughout the land of Egypt the dust will become gnats."

8.zh: 他们就这样行。亚伦伸杖击打地上的尘土，就在人身上和牲畜身上有了虱子；埃及遍地的尘土都变成虱子了。
8.en: They did this, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with the staff and struck the dust of the ground, gnats came upon men and animals. All the dust throughout the land of Egypt became gnats.

8.zh: 行法术的也用邪术要生出虱子来，却是不能。于是在人身上和牲畜身上都有了虱子。
8.en: But when the magicians tried to produce gnats by their secret arts, they could not. And the gnats were on men and animals.

8.zh: 行法术的就对法老说：这是神的手段。法老心里刚硬，不肯听摩西 、 亚伦，正如耶和华所说的。
8.en: The magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is the finger of God." But Pharaoh's heart was hard and he would not listen, just as the Lord had said.

8.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你清早起来，法老来到水边，你站在他面前，对他说：耶和华这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
8.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh as he goes to the water and say to him, 'This is what the Lord says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

8.zh: 你若不容我的百姓去，我要叫成群的苍蝇到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，进你的房屋，并且埃及人的房屋和他们所住的地都要满了成群的苍蝇。
8.en: If you do not let my people go, I will send swarms of flies on you and your officials, on your people and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians will be full of flies, and even the ground where they are.

8.zh: 当那日，我必分别我百姓所住的歌珊地，使那里没有成群的苍蝇，好叫你知道我是天下的耶和华。
8.en: " 'But on that day I will deal differently with the land of Goshen, where my people live; no swarms of flies will be there, so that you will know that I, the Lord , am in this land.

8.zh: 我要将我的百姓和你的百姓分别出来。明天必有这神迹。
8.en: I will make a distinction between my people and your people. This miraculous sign will occur tomorrow.' "

8.zh: 耶和华就这样行。苍蝇成了大群，进入法老的宫殿，和他臣仆的房屋；埃及遍地就因这成群的苍蝇败坏了。
8.en: And the Lord did this. Dense swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh's palace and into the houses of his officials, and throughout Egypt the land was ruined by the flies.

8.zh: 法老召了摩西 、 亚伦来，说：你们去，在这地祭祀你们的神罢！
8.en: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God here in the land."

8.zh: 摩西说：这样行本不相宜，因为我们要把埃及人所厌恶的祭祀耶和华 ─ 我们的神；若把埃及人所厌恶的在他们眼前献为祭，他们岂不拿石头打死我们么？
8.en: But Moses said, "That would not be right. The sacrifices we offer the Lord our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. And if we offer sacrifices that are detestable in their eyes, will they not stone us?

8.zh: 我们要往旷野去，走三天的路程，照著耶和华 ─ 我们神所要吩咐我们的祭祀他。
8.en: We must take a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God, as he commands us."

8.zh: 法老说：我容你们去，在旷野祭祀耶和华 ─ 你们的神；只是不要走得很远。求你们为我祈祷。
8.en: Pharaoh said, "I will let you go to offer sacrifices to the Lord your God in the desert, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me."

8.zh: 摩西说：我要出去求耶和华，使成群的苍蝇明天离开法老和法老的臣仆并法老的百姓；法老却不可再行诡诈，不容百姓去祭祀耶和华。
8.en: Moses answered, "As soon as I leave you, I will pray to the Lord , and tomorrow the flies will leave Pharaoh and his officials and his people. Only be sure that Pharaoh does not act deceitfully again by not letting the people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord ."

8.zh: 于是摩西离开法老去求耶和华。
8.en: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord ,

8.zh: 耶和华就照摩西的话行，叫成群的苍蝇离开法老和他的臣仆并他的百姓，一个也没有留下。
8.en: and the Lord did what Moses asked: The flies left Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not a fly remained.

8.zh: 这一次法老又硬著心，不容百姓去。
8.en: But this time also Pharaoh hardened his heart and would not let the people go.

9.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：你进去见法老，对他说：耶和华 ─ 希伯来人的神这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
9.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: "Let my people go, so that they may worship me."

9.zh: 你若不肯容他们去，仍旧强留他们，
9.en: If you refuse to let them go and continue to hold them back,

9.zh: 耶和华的手加在你田间的牲畜上，就是在马 、 驴 、 骆驼 、 牛群 、 羊群上，必有重重的瘟疫。
9.en: the hand of the Lord will bring a terrible plague on your livestock in the field-on your horses and donkeys and camels and on your cattle and sheep and goats.

9.zh: 耶和华要分别以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜，凡属以色列人的，一样都不死。
9.en: But the Lord will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and that of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.' "

9.zh: 耶和华就定了时候，说：明天耶和华必在此地行这事。
9.en: The Lord set a time and said, "Tomorrow the Lord will do this in the land."

9.zh: 第二天，耶和华就行这事。埃及的牲畜几乎都死了，只是以色列人的牲畜，一个都没有死。
9.en: And the next day the Lord did it: All the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal belonging to the Israelites died.

9.zh: 法老打发人去看，谁知以色列人的牲畜连一个都没有死。法老的心却是固执，不容百姓去。
9.en: Pharaoh sent men to investigate and found that not even one of the animals of the Israelites had died. Yet his heart was unyielding and he would not let the people go.

9.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西 、 亚伦说：你们取几捧炉灰，摩西要在法老面前向天扬起来。
9.en: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Take handfuls of soot from a furnace and have Moses toss it into the air in the presence of Pharaoh.

9.zh: 这灰要在埃及全地变作尘土，在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。
9.en: It will become fine dust over the whole land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on men and animals throughout the land."

9.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦取了炉灰，站在法老面前。摩西向天扬起来，就在人身上和牲畜身上成了起泡的疮。
9.en: So they took soot from a furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and festering boils broke out on men and animals.

9.zh: 行法术的在摩西面前站立不住，因为在他们身上和一切埃及人身上都有这疮。
9.en: The magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils that were on them and on all the Egyptians.

9.zh: 耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不听他们，正如耶和华对摩西所说的。
9.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the Lord had said to Moses.

9.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你清早起来，站在法老面前，对他说：耶和华 ─ 希伯来人的神这样说：容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
9.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning, confront Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me,

9.zh: 因为这一次我要叫一切的灾殃临到你和你臣仆并你百姓的身上，叫你知道在普天下没有像我的。
9.en: or this time I will send the full force of my plagues against you and against your officials and your people, so you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

9.zh: 我若伸手用瘟疫攻击你和你的百姓，你早就从地上除灭了。
9.en: For by now I could have stretched out my hand and struck you and your people with a plague that would have wiped you off the earth.

9.zh: 其实，我叫你存立，是特要向你显我的大能，并要使我的名传遍天下。
9.en: But I have raised you up for this very purpose, that I might show you my power and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.

9.zh: 你还向我的百姓自高，不容他们去么？
9.en: You still set yourself against my people and will not let them go.

9.zh: 到明天约在这时候，我必叫重大的冰雹降下，自从埃及开国以来，没有这样的冰雹。
9.en: Therefore, at this time tomorrow I will send the worst hailstorm that has ever fallen on Egypt, from the day it was founded till now.

9.zh: 现在你要打发人把你的牲畜和你田间一切所有的催进来；凡在田间不收回家的，无论是人是牲畜，冰雹必降在他们身上，他们就必死。
9.en: Give an order now to bring your livestock and everything you have in the field to a place of shelter, because the hail will fall on every man and animal that has not been brought in and is still out in the field, and they will die.' "

9.zh: 法老的臣仆中，惧怕耶和华这话的，便叫他的奴仆和牲畜跑进家来。
9.en: Those officials of Pharaoh who feared the word of the Lord hurried to bring their slaves and their livestock inside.

9.zh: 但那不把耶和华这话放在心上的，就将他的奴仆和牲畜留在田里。
9.en: But those who ignored the word of the Lord left their slaves and livestock in the field.

9.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你向天伸杖，使埃及遍地的人身上和牲畜身上，并田间各样菜蔬上，都有冰雹。
9.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that hail will fall all over Egypt-on men and animals and on everything growing in the fields of Egypt."

9.zh: 摩西向天伸杖，耶和华就打雷下雹，有火闪到地上；耶和华下雹在埃及地上。
9.en: When Moses stretched out his staff toward the sky, the Lord sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the ground. So the Lord rained hail on the land of Egypt;

9.zh: 那时，雹与火搀杂，甚是利害，自从埃及成国以来，遍地没有这样的。
9.en: hail fell and lightning flashed back and forth. It was the worst storm in all the land of Egypt since it had become a nation.

9.zh: 在埃及遍地，雹击打了田间所有的人和牲畜，并一切的菜蔬，又打坏田间一切的树木。
9.en: Throughout Egypt hail struck everything in the fields-both men and animals; it beat down everything growing in the fields and stripped every tree.

9.zh: 惟独以色列人所住的歌珊地没有冰雹。
9.en: The only place it did not hail was the land of Goshen, where the Israelites were.

9.zh: 法老打发人召摩西 、 亚伦来，对他们说：这一次我犯了罪了。耶和华是公义的；我和我的百姓是邪恶的。
9.en: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron. "This time I have sinned," he said to them. "The Lord is in the right, and I and my people are in the wrong.

9.zh: 这雷轰和冰雹已经够了。请你们求耶和华，我就容你们去，不再留住你们。
9.en: Pray to the Lord , for we have had enough thunder and hail. I will let you go; you don't have to stay any longer."

9.zh: 摩西对他说：我一出城，就要向耶和华举手祷告；雷必止住，也不再有冰雹，叫你知道全地都是属耶和华的。
9.en: Moses replied, "When I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands in prayer to the Lord . The thunder will stop and there will be no more hail, so you may know that the earth is the Lord 's.

9.zh: 至于你和你的臣仆，我知道你们还是不惧怕耶和华神。
9.en: But I know that you and your officials still do not fear the Lord God."

9.zh: 那时，麻和大麦被雹击打；因为大麦已经吐穗，麻也开了花。
9.en: (The flax and barley were destroyed, since the barley had headed and the flax was in bloom.

9.zh: 只是小麦和粗麦没有被击打，因为还没有长成。）
9.en: The wheat and spelt, however, were not destroyed, because they ripen later.)

9.zh: 摩西离了法老出城，向耶和华举手祷告；雷和雹就止住，雨也不再浇在地上了。
9.en: Then Moses left Pharaoh and went out of the city. He spread out his hands toward the Lord ; the thunder and hail stopped, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.

9.zh: 法老见雨和雹与雷止住，就越发犯罪；他和他的臣仆都硬著心。
9.en: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had stopped, he sinned again: He and his officials hardened their hearts.

9.zh: 法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人去，正如耶和华藉著摩西所说的。
9.en: So Pharaoh's heart was hard and he would not let the Israelites go, just as the Lord had said through Moses.

10.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你进去见法老。我使他和他臣仆的心刚硬，为要在他们中间显我这些神迹，
10.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the hearts of his officials so that I may perform these miraculous signs of mine among them

10.zh: 并要叫你将我向埃及人所做的事，和在他们中间所行的神迹，传于你儿子和你孙子的耳中，好叫你们知道我是耶和华。
10.en: that you may tell your children and grandchildren how I dealt harshly with the Egyptians and how I performed my signs among them, and that you may know that I am the Lord ."

10.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦就进去见法老，对他说：耶和华 ─ 希伯来人的神这样说：你在我面前不肯自卑要到几时呢？容我的百姓去，好事奉我。
10.en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said to him, "This is what the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says: 'How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

10.zh: 你若不肯容我的百姓去，明天我要使蝗虫进入你的境内，
10.en: If you refuse to let them go, I will bring locusts into your country tomorrow.

10.zh: 遮满地面，甚至看不见地，并且吃那冰雹所剩的和田间所长的一切树木。
10.en: They will cover the face of the ground so that it cannot be seen. They will devour what little you have left after the hail, including every tree that is growing in your fields.

10.zh: 你的宫殿和你众臣仆的房屋，并一切埃及人的房屋，都要被蝗虫占满了；自从你祖宗和你祖宗的祖宗在世以来，直到今日，没有见过这样的灾。摩西就转身离开法老出去。
10.en: They will fill your houses and those of all your officials and all the Egyptians-something neither your fathers nor your forefathers have ever seen from the day they settled in this land till now.' " Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh.

10.zh: 法老的臣仆对法老说：这人为我们的网罗要到几时呢？容这些人去事奉耶和华 ─ 他们的神罢！埃及已经败坏了，你还不知道么？
10.en: Pharaoh's officials said to him, "How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the people go, so that they may worship the Lord their God. Do you not yet realize that Egypt is ruined?"

10.zh: 于是摩西 、 亚伦被召回来见法老；法老对他们说：你们去事奉耶和华 ─ 你们的神；但那要去的是谁呢？
10.en: Then Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. "Go, worship the Lord your God," he said. "But just who will be going?"

10.zh: 摩西说：我们要和我们老的少的 、 儿子女儿同去，且把羊群牛群一同带去，因为我们务要向耶和华守节。
10.en: Moses answered, "We will go with our young and old, with our sons and daughters, and with our flocks and herds, because we are to celebrate a festival to the Lord ."

10.zh: 法老对他们说：我容你们和你们妇人孩子去的时候，耶和华与你们同在罢！你们要谨慎；因为有祸在你们眼前（或作：你们存著恶意），
10.en: Pharaoh said, "The Lord be with you-if I let you go, along with your women and children! Clearly you are bent on evil.

10.zh: 不可都去！你们这壮年人去事奉耶和华罢，因为这是你们所求的。于是把他们从法老面前撵出去。
10.en: No! Have only the men go; and worship the Lord , since that's what you have been asking for." Then Moses and Aaron were driven out of Pharaoh's presence.

10.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你向埃及地伸杖，使蝗虫到埃及地上来，吃地上一切的菜蔬，就是冰雹所剩的。
10.en: And the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over Egypt so that locusts will swarm over the land and devour everything growing in the fields, everything left by the hail."

10.zh: 摩西就向埃及地伸杖，那一昼一夜，耶和华使东风刮在埃及地上；到了早晨，东风把蝗虫刮了来。
10.en: So Moses stretched out his staff over Egypt, and the Lord made an east wind blow across the land all that day and all that night. By morning the wind had brought the locusts;

10.zh: 蝗虫上来，落在埃及的四境，甚是厉害；以前没有这样的，以后也必没有。
10.en: they invaded all Egypt and settled down in every area of the country in great numbers. Never before had there been such a plague of locusts, nor will there ever be again.

10.zh: 因为这蝗虫遮满地面，甚至地都黑暗了，又吃地上一切的菜蔬和冰雹所剩树上的果子。埃及遍地，无论是树木，是田间的菜蔬，连一点青的也没有留下。
10.en: They covered all the ground until it was black. They devoured all that was left after the hail-everything growing in the fields and the fruit on the trees. Nothing green remained on tree or plant in all the land of Egypt.

10.zh: 于是法老急忙召了摩西 、 亚伦来，说：我得罪耶和华 ─ 你们的神，又得罪了你们。
10.en: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.

10.zh: 现在求你，只这一次，饶恕我的罪，求耶和华 ─ 你们的神使我脱离这一次的死亡。
10.en: Now forgive my sin once more and pray to the Lord your God to take this deadly plague away from me."

10.zh: 摩西就离开法老去求耶和华。
10.en: Moses then left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord .

10.zh: 耶和华转了极大的西风，把蝗虫刮起，吹入红海；在埃及的四境连一个也没有留下。
10.en: And the Lord changed the wind to a very strong west wind, which caught up the locusts and carried them into the Red Sea. Not a locust was left anywhere in Egypt.

10.zh: 但耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人去。
10.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let the Israelites go.

10.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你向天伸杖，使埃及地黑暗；这黑暗似乎摸得著。
10.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that darkness will spread over Egypt-darkness that can be felt."

10.zh: 摩西向天伸杖，埃及遍地就乌黑了三天。
10.en: So Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and total darkness covered all Egypt for three days.

10.zh: 三天之久，人不能相见，谁也不敢起来离开本处；惟有以色列人家中都有亮光。
10.en: No one could see anyone else or leave his place for three days. Yet all the Israelites had light in the places where they lived.

10.zh: 法老就召摩西来，说：你们去事奉耶和华；只是你们的羊群牛群要留下；你们的妇人孩子可以和你们同去。
10.en: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and said, "Go, worship the Lord . Even your women and children may go with you; only leave your flocks and herds behind."

10.zh: 摩西说：你总要把祭物和燔祭牲交给我们，使我们可以祭祀耶和华 ─ 我们的神。
10.en: But Moses said, "You must allow us to have sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the Lord our God.

10.zh: 我们的牲畜也要带去，连一蹄也不留下；因为我们要从其中取出来，事奉耶和华 ─ 我们的神。我们未到那里，还不知道用甚么事奉耶和华。
10.en: Our livestock too must go with us; not a hoof is to be left behind. We have to use some of them in worshiping the Lord our God, and until we get there we will not know what we are to use to worship the Lord ."

10.zh: 但耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不肯容他们去。
10.en: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he was not willing to let them go.

10.zh: 法老对摩西说：你离开我去罢，你要小心，不要再见我的面！因为你见我面的那日你就必死！
10.en: Pharaoh said to Moses, "Get out of my sight! Make sure you do not appear before me again! The day you see my face you will die."

10.zh: 摩西说：你说得好！我必不再见你的面了。
10.en: "Just as you say," Moses replied, "I will never appear before you again."

11.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：我再使一样的灾殃临到法老和埃及，然后他必容你们离开这地。他容你们去的时候，总要催逼你们都从这地出去。
11.en: Now the Lord had said to Moses, "I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that, he will let you go from here, and when he does, he will drive you out completely.

11.zh: 你要传于百姓的耳中，叫他们男女各人向邻舍要金器银器。
11.en: Tell the people that men and women alike are to ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold."

11.zh: 耶和华叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，并且摩西在埃及地 、 法老臣仆，和百姓的眼中看为极大。
11.en: (The Lord made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh's officials and by the people.)

11.zh: 摩西说：耶和华这样说：约到半夜，我必出去巡行埃及遍地。
11.en: So Moses said, "This is what the Lord says: 'About midnight I will go throughout Egypt.

11.zh: 凡在埃及地，从坐宝座的法老直到磨子后的婢女所有的长子，以及一切头生的牲畜，都必死。
11.en: Every firstborn son in Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh, who sits on the throne, to the firstborn son of the slave girl, who is at her hand mill, and all the firstborn of the cattle as well.

11.zh: 埃及遍地必有大哀号；从前没有这样的，后来也必没有。
11.en: There will be loud wailing throughout Egypt-worse than there has ever been or ever will be again.

11.zh: 至于以色列中，无论是人是牲畜，连狗也不敢向他们摇舌，好叫你们知道耶和华是将埃及人和以色列人分别出来。
11.en: But among the Israelites not a dog will bark at any man or animal.' Then you will know that the Lord makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

11.zh: 你这一切臣仆都要俯伏来见我，说：求你和跟从你的百姓都出去，然后我要出去。于是，摩西气忿忿的离开法老，出去了。
11.en: All these officials of yours will come to me, bowing down before me and saying, 'Go, you and all the people who follow you!' After that I will leave." Then Moses, hot with anger, left Pharaoh.

11.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：法老必不听你们，使我的奇事在埃及地多起来。
11.en: The Lord had said to Moses, "Pharaoh will refuse to listen to you-so that my wonders may be multiplied in Egypt."

11.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦在法老面前行了这一切奇事；耶和华使法老的心刚硬，不容以色列人出离他的地。
11.en: Moses and Aaron performed all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let the Israelites go out of his country.

12.zh: 耶和华在埃及地晓谕摩西 、 亚伦说：
12.en: The Lord said to Moses andAaron in Egypt,

12.zh: 你们要以本月为正月，为一年之首。
12.en: "This month is to be for you the first month, the first month of your year.

12.zh: 你们吩咐以色列全会众说：本月初十日，各人要按著父家取羊羔，一家一只。
12.en: Tell the whole community of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each man is to take a lamb for his family, one for each household.

12.zh: 若是一家的人太少，吃不了一只羊羔，本人就要和他隔壁的邻舍共取一只。你们预备羊羔，要按著人数和饭量计算。
12.en: If any household is too small for a whole lamb, they must share one with their nearest neighbor, having taken into account the number of people there are. You are to determine the amount of lamb needed in accordance with what each person will eat.

12.zh: 要无残疾 、 一岁的公羊羔，你们或从绵羊里取，或从山羊里取，都可以。
12.en: The animals you choose must be year-old males without defect, and you may take them from the sheep or the goats.

12.zh: 要留到本月十四日，在黄昏的时候，以色列全会众把羊羔宰了。
12.en: Take care of them until the fourteenth day of the month, when all the people of the community of Israel must slaughter them at twilight.

12.zh: 各家要取点血，涂在吃羊羔的房屋左右的门框上和门楣上。
12.en: Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.

12.zh: 当夜要吃羊羔的肉；用火烤了，与无酵饼和苦菜同吃。
12.en: That same night they are to eat the meat roasted over the fire, along with bitter herbs, and bread made without yeast.

12.zh: 不可吃生的，断不可吃水煮的，要带著头 、 腿 、 五脏，用火烤了吃。
12.en: Do not eat the meat raw or cooked in water, but roast it over the fire-head, legs and inner parts.

12.zh: 不可剩下一点留到早晨；若留到早晨，要用火烧了。
12.en: Do not leave any of it till morning; if some is left till morning, you must burn it.

12.zh: 你们吃羊羔当腰间束带，脚上穿鞋，手中拿杖，赶紧的吃；这是耶和华的逾越节。
12.en: This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the Lord 's Passover.

12.zh: 因为那夜我要巡行埃及地，把埃及地一切头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都击杀了，又要败坏埃及一切的神。我是耶和华。
12.en: "On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn-both men and animals-and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I am the Lord .

12.zh: 这血要在你们所住的房屋上作记号；我一见这血，就越过你们去。我击杀埃及地头生的时候，灾殃必不临到你们身上灭你们。
12.en: The blood will be a sign for you on the houses where you are; and when I see the blood, I will pass over you. No destructive plague will touch you when I strike Egypt.

12.zh: 你们要记念这日，守为耶和华的节，作为你们世世代代永远的定例。
12.en: "This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord -a lasting ordinance.

12.zh: 你们要吃无酵饼七日。头一日要把酵从你们各家中除去；因为从头一日起，到第七日为止，凡吃有酵之饼的，必从以色列中剪除。
12.en: For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast. On the first day remove the yeast from your houses, for whoever eats anything with yeast in it from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel.

12.zh: 头一日你们当有圣会，第七日也当有圣会。这两日之内，除了预备各人所要吃的以外，无论何工都不可做。
12.en: On the first day hold a sacred assembly, and another one on the seventh day. Do no work at all on these days, except to prepare food for everyone to eat-that is all you may do.

12.zh: 你们要守无酵节，因为我正当这日把你们的军队从埃及地领出来。所以，你们要守这日，作为世世代代永远的定例。
12.en: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread, because it was on this very day that I brought your divisions out of Egypt. Celebrate this day as a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

12.zh: 从正月十四日晚上，直到二十一日晚上，你们要吃无酵饼。
12.en: In the first month you are to eat bread made without yeast, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day.

12.zh: 在你们各家中，七日之内不可有酵；因为凡吃有酵之物的，无论是寄居的，是本地的，必从以色列的会中剪除。
12.en: For seven days no yeast is to be found in your houses. And whoever eats anything with yeast in it must be cut off from the community of Israel, whether he is an alien or native-born.

12.zh: 有酵的物，你们都不可吃；在你们一切住处要吃无酵饼。
12.en: Eat nothing made with yeast. Wherever you live, you must eat unleavened bread."

12.zh: 于是，摩西召了以色列的众长老来，对他们说：你们要按著家口取出羊羔，把这逾越节的羊羔宰了。
12.en: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go at once and select the animals for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb.

12.zh: 拿一把牛膝草，蘸盆里的血，打在门楣上和左右的门框上。你们谁也不可出自己的房门，直到早晨。
12.en: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin and put some of the blood on the top and on both sides of the doorframe. Not one of you shall go out the door of his house until morning.

12.zh: 因为耶和华要巡行击杀埃及人，他看见血在门楣上和左右的门框上，就必越过那门，不容灭命的进你们的房屋，击杀你们。
12.en: When the Lord goes through the land to strike down the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway, and he will not permit the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down.

12.zh: 这例，你们要守著，作为你们和你们子孙永远的定例。
12.en: "Obey these instructions as a lasting ordinance for you and your descendants.

12.zh: 日后，你们到了耶和华按著所应许赐给你们的那地，就要守这礼。
12.en: When you enter the land that the Lord will give you as he promised, observe this ceremony.

12.zh: 你们的儿女问你们说：行这礼是甚么意思？
12.en: And when your children ask you, 'What does this ceremony mean to you?'

12.zh: 你们就说：这是献给耶和华逾越节的祭。当以色列人在埃及的时候，他击杀埃及人，越过以色列人的房屋，救了我们各家。于是百姓低头下拜。
12.en: then tell them, 'It is the Passover sacrifice to the Lord , who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt and spared our homes when he struck down the Egyptians.' " Then the people bowed down and worshiped.

12.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西 、 亚伦，以色列人就怎样行。
12.en: The Israelites did just what the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.

12.zh: 到了半夜，耶和华把埃及地所有的长子，就是从坐宝座的法老，直到被掳囚在监里之人的长子，以及一切头生的牲畜，尽都杀了。
12.en: At midnight the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on the throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner, who was in the dungeon, and the firstborn of all the livestock as well.

12.zh: 法老和一切臣仆，并埃及众人，夜间都起来了。在埃及有大哀号，无一家不死一个人的。
12.en: Pharaoh and all his officials and all the Egyptians got up during the night, and there was loud wailing in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.

12.zh: 夜间，法老召了摩西 、 亚伦来，说：起来！连你们带以色列人，从我民中出去，依你们所说的，去事奉耶和华罢！
12.en: During the night Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Up! Leave my people, you and the Israelites! Go, worship the Lord as you have requested.

12.zh: 也依你们所说的，连羊群牛群带著走罢！并要为我祝福。
12.en: Take your flocks and herds, as you have said, and go. And also bless me."

12.zh: 埃及人催促百姓，打发他们快快出离那地，因为埃及人说：我们都要死了。
12.en: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the country. "For otherwise," they said, "we will all die!"

12.zh: 百姓就拿著没有酵的生面，把抟面盆包在衣服中，扛在肩头上。
12.en: So the people took their dough before the yeast was added, and carried it on their shoulders in kneading troughs wrapped in clothing.

12.zh: 以色列人照著摩西的话行，向埃及人要金器 、 银器，和衣裳。
12.en: The Israelites did as Moses instructed and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold and for clothing.

12.zh: 耶和华叫百姓在埃及人眼前蒙恩，以致埃及人给他们所要的。他们就把埃及人的财物夺去了。
12.en: The Lord had made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and they gave them what they asked for; so they plundered the Egyptians.

12.zh: 以色列人从兰塞起行，往疏割去；除了妇人孩子，步行的男人约有六十万。
12.en: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth. There were about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children.

12.zh: 又有许多闲杂人，并有羊群牛群，和他们一同上去。
12.en: Many other people went up with them, as well as large droves of livestock, both flocks and herds.

12.zh: 他们用埃及带出来的生面烤成无酵饼。这生面原没有发起；因为他们被催逼离开埃及，不能耽延，也没有为自己预备甚么食物。
12.en: With the dough they had brought from Egypt, they baked cakes of unleavened bread. The dough was without yeast because they had been driven out of Egypt and did not have time to prepare food for themselves.

12.zh: 以色列人住在埃及共有四百三十年。
12.en: Now the length of time the Israelite people lived in Egypt was 430 years.

12.zh: 正满了四百三十年的那一天，耶和华的军队都从埃及地出来了。
12.en: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the Lord 's divisions left Egypt.

12.zh: 这夜是耶和华的夜；因耶和华领他们出了埃及地，所以当向耶和华谨守，是以色列众人世世代代该谨守的。
12.en: Because the Lord kept vigil that night to bring them out of Egypt, on this night all the Israelites are to keep vigil to honor the Lord for the generations to come.

12.zh: 耶和华对摩西 、 亚伦说：逾越节的例是这样：外邦人都不可吃这羊羔。
12.en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "These are the regulations for the Passover: "No foreigner is to eat of it.

12.zh: 但各人用银子买的奴仆，既受了割礼就可以吃。
12.en: Any slave you have bought may eat of it after you have circumcised him,

12.zh: 寄居的和雇工人都不可吃。
12.en: but a temporary resident and a hired worker may not eat of it.

12.zh: 应当在一个房子里吃；不可把一点肉从房子里带到外头去。羊羔的骨头一根也不可折断。
12.en: "It must be eaten inside one house; take none of the meat outside the house. Do not break any of the bones.

12.zh: 以色列全会众都要守这礼。
12.en: The whole community of Israel must celebrate it.

12.zh: 若有外人寄居在你们中间，愿向耶和华守逾越节，他所有的男子务要受割礼，然后才容他前来遵守，他也就像本地人一样；但未受割礼的，都不可吃这羊羔。
12.en: "An alien living among you who wants to celebrate the Lord 's Passover must have all the males in his household circumcised; then he may take part like one born in the land. No uncircumcised male may eat of it.

12.zh: 本地人和寄居在你们中间的外人同归一例。
12.en: The same law applies to the native-born and to the alien living among you."

12.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西 、 亚伦，以色列众人就怎样行了。
12.en: All the Israelites did just what the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.

12.zh: 正当那日，耶和华将以色列人按著他们的军队，从埃及地领出来。
12.en: And on that very day the Lord brought the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.

13.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
13.en: The Lord said to Moses,

13.zh: 以色列中凡头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都是我的，要分别为圣归我。
13.en: "Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether man or animal."

13.zh: 摩西对百姓说：你们要记念从埃及为奴之家出来的这日，因为耶和华用大能的手将你们从这地方领出来。有酵的饼都不可吃。
13.en: Then Moses said to the people, "Commemorate this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery, because the Lord brought you out of it with a mighty hand. Eat nothing containing yeast.

13.zh: 亚笔月间的这日是你们出来的日子。
13.en: Today, in the month of Abib, you are leaving.

13.zh: 将来耶和华领你进迦南人 、 赫人 、 亚摩利人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人之地，就是他向你的祖宗起誓应许给你那流奶与蜜之地，那时你要在这月间守这礼。
13.en: When the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites-the land he swore to your forefathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey-you are to observe this ceremony in this month:

13.zh: 你要吃无酵饼七日，到第七日要向耶和华守节。
13.en: For seven days eat bread made without yeast and on the seventh day hold a festival to the Lord .

13.zh: 这七日之久，要吃无酵饼；在你四境之内不可见有酵的饼，也不可见发酵的物。
13.en: Eat unleavened bread during those seven days; nothing with yeast in it is to be seen among you, nor shall any yeast be seen anywhere within your borders.

13.zh: 当那日，你要告诉你的儿子说：这是因耶和华在我出埃及的时候为我所行的事。
13.en: On that day tell your son, 'I do this because of what the Lord did for me when I came out of Egypt.'

13.zh: 这要在你手上作记号，在你额上作纪念，使耶和华的律法常在你口中，因为耶和华曾用大能的手将你从埃及领出来。
13.en: This observance will be for you like a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the law of the Lord is to be on your lips. For the Lord brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand.

13.zh: 所以你每年要按著日期守这例。
13.en: You must keep this ordinance at the appointed time year after year.

13.zh: 将来，耶和华照他向你和你祖宗所起的誓将你领进迦南人之地，把这地赐给你，
13.en: "After the Lord brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as he promised on oath to you and your forefathers,

13.zh: 那时你要将一切头生的，并牲畜中头生的，归给耶和华；公的都要属耶和华。
13.en: you are to give over to the Lord the first offspring of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the Lord .

13.zh: 凡头生的驴，你要用羊羔代赎；若不代赎，就要打折他的颈项。凡你儿子中头生的都要赎出来。
13.en: Redeem with a lamb every firstborn donkey, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn among your sons.

13.zh: 日后，你的儿子问你说：这是甚么意思？你就说：耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及为奴之家领出来。
13.en: "In days to come, when your son asks you, 'What does this mean?' say to him, 'With a mighty hand the Lord brought us out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

13.zh: 那时法老几乎不容我们去，耶和华就把埃及地所有头生的，无论是人是牲畜，都杀了。因此，我把一切头生的公牲畜献给耶和华为祭，但将头生的儿子都赎出来。
13.en: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the Lord killed every firstborn in Egypt, both man and animal. This is why I sacrifice to the Lord the first male offspring of every womb and redeem each of my firstborn sons.'

13.zh: 这要在你手上作记号，在你额上作经文，因为耶和华用大能的手将我们从埃及领出来。
13.en: And it will be like a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand."

13.zh: 法老容百姓去的时候，非利士地的道路虽近，神却不领他们从那里走；因为神说：恐怕百姓遇见打仗后悔，就回埃及去。
13.en: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them on the road through the Philistine country, though that was shorter. For God said, "If they face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt."

13.zh: 所以神领百姓绕道而行，走红海旷野的路。以色列人出埃及地，都带著兵器上去。
13.en: So God led the people around by the desert road toward the Red Sea. The Israelites went up out of Egypt armed for battle.

13.zh: 摩西把约瑟的骸骨一同带去；因为约瑟曾叫以色列人严严地起誓，对他们说：神必眷顾你们，你们要把我的骸骨从这里一同带上去。
13.en: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear an oath. He had said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up with you from this place."

13.zh: 他们从疏割起行，在旷野边的以倘安营。
13.en: After leaving Succoth they camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.

13.zh: 日间，耶和华在云柱中领他们的路；夜间，在火柱中光照他们，使他们日夜都可以行走。
13.en: By day the Lord went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by day or night.

13.zh: 日间云柱，夜间火柱，总不离开百姓的面前。
13.en: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.

14.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
14.en: Then the Lord said to Moses,

14.zh: 你吩咐以色列人转回，安营在比哈希录前，密夺和海的中间，对著巴力洗分，靠近海边安营。
14.en: "Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp near Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. They are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal Zephon.

14.zh: 法老必说：以色列人在地中绕迷了，旷野把他们困住了。
14.en: Pharaoh will think, 'The Israelites are wandering around the land in confusion, hemmed in by the desert.'

14.zh: 我要使法老的心刚硬，他要追赶他们，我便在法老和他全军身上得荣耀；埃及人就知道我是耶和华。于是以色列人这样行了。
14.en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and he will pursue them. But I will gain glory for myself through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord ." So the Israelites did this.

14.zh: 有人告诉埃及王说：百姓逃跑。法老和他的臣仆就向百姓变心，说：我们容以色列人去，不再服事我们，这做的是甚么事呢？
14.en: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, "What have we done? We have let the Israelites go and have lost their services!"

14.zh: 法老就预备他的车辆，带领军兵同去，
14.en: So he had his chariot made ready and took his army with him.

14.zh: 并带著六百辆特选的车和埃及所有的车，每辆都有车兵长。
14.en: He took six hundred of the best chariots, along with all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.

14.zh: 耶和华使埃及王法老的心刚硬，他就追赶以色列人，因为以色列人是昂然无惧地出埃及。
14.en: The Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out boldly.

14.zh: 埃及人追赶他们，法老一切的马匹 、 车辆 、 马兵，与军兵就在海边上，靠近比哈希录，对著巴力洗分，在他们安营的地方追上了。
14.en: The Egyptians-all Pharaoh's horses and chariots, horsemen and troops-pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi Hahiroth, opposite Baal Zephon.

14.zh: 法老临近的时候，以色列人举目看见埃及人赶来，就甚惧怕，向耶和华哀求。
14.en: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up, and there were the Egyptians, marching after them. They were terrified and cried out to the Lord .

14.zh: 他们对摩西说：难道在埃及没有坟地，你把我们带来死在旷野么？你为甚么这样待我们，将我们从埃及领出来呢？
14.en: They said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us to the desert to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?

14.zh: 我们在埃及岂没有对你说过，不要搅扰我们，容我们服事埃及人么？因为服事埃及人比死在旷野还好。
14.en: Didn't we say to you in Egypt, 'Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians'? It would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the desert!"

14.zh: 摩西对百姓说：不要惧怕，只管站住！看耶和华今天向你们所要施行的救恩。因为，你们今天所看见的埃及人必永远不再看见了。
14.en: Moses answered the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the Lord will bring you today. The Egyptians you see today you will never see again.

14.zh: 耶和华必为你们争战；你们只管静默，不要作声。
14.en: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still."

14.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你为甚么向我哀求呢？你吩咐以色列人往前走。
14.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.

14.zh: 你举手向海伸杖，把水分开。以色列人要下海中走干地。
14.en: Raise your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea to divide the water so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.

14.zh: 我要使埃及人的心刚硬，他们就跟著下去。我要在法老和他的全军 、 车辆 、 马兵上得荣耀。
14.en: I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. And I will gain glory through Pharaoh and all his army, through his chariots and his horsemen.

14.zh: 我在法老和他的车辆 、 马兵上得荣耀的时候，埃及人就知道我是耶和华了。
14.en: The Egyptians will know that I am the Lord when I gain glory through Pharaoh, his chariots and his horsemen."

14.zh: 在以色列营前行走神的使者，转到他们后边去；云柱也从他们前边转到他们后边立住。
14.en: Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel's army, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from in front and stood behind them,

14.zh: 在埃及营和以色列营中间有云柱，一边黑暗，一边发光，终夜两下不得相近。
14.en: coming between the armies of Egypt and Israel. Throughout the night the cloud brought darkness to the one side and light to the other side; so neither went near the other all night long.

14.zh: 摩西向海伸杖，耶和华便用大东风，使海水一夜退去，水便分开，海就成了干地。
14.en: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided,

14.zh: 以色列人下海中走干地，水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
14.en: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

14.zh: 埃及人追赶他们，法老一切的马匹 、 车辆，和马兵都跟著下到海中。
14.en: The Egyptians pursued them, and all Pharaoh's horses and chariots and horsemen followed them into the sea.

14.zh: 到了晨更的时候，耶和华从云火柱中向埃及的军兵观看，使埃及的军兵混乱了；
14.en: During the last watch of the night the Lord looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud at the Egyptian army and threw it into confusion.

14.zh: 又使他们的车轮脱落难以行走，以致埃及人说：我们从以色列人面前逃跑罢！因耶和华为他们攻击我们了
14.en: He made the wheels of their chariots come off so that they had difficulty driving. And the Egyptians said, "Let's get away from the Israelites! The Lord is fighting for them against Egypt."

14.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你向海伸杖，叫水仍合在埃及人并他们的车辆 、 马兵身上。
14.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen."

14.zh: 摩西就向海伸杖，到了天一亮，海水仍旧复原。埃及人避水逃跑的时候，耶和华把他们推翻在海中，
14.en: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea went back to its place. The Egyptians were fleeing toward it, and the Lord swept them into the sea.

14.zh: 水就回流，淹没了车辆和马兵。那些跟著以色列人下海法老的全军，连一个也没有剩下。
14.en: The water flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen-the entire army of Pharaoh that had followed the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.

14.zh: 以色列人却在海中走干地；水在他们的左右作了墙垣。
14.en: But the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

14.zh: 当日，耶和华这样拯救以色列人脱离埃及人的手，以色列人看见埃及人的死尸都在海边了。
14.en: That day the Lord saved Israel from the hands of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians lying dead on the shore.

14.zh: 以色列人看见耶和华向埃及人所行的大事，就敬畏耶和华，又信服他和他的仆人摩西。
14.en: And when the Israelites saw the great power the Lord displayed against the Egyptians, the people feared the Lord and put their trust in him and in Moses his servant.

15.zh: 那时，摩西和以色列人向耶和华唱歌说：我要向耶和华歌唱，因他大大战胜，将马和骑马的投在海中。
15.en: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord : "I will sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. The horse and its rider he has hurled into the sea.

15.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌，也成了我的拯救。这是我的神，我要赞美他，是我父亲的神，我要尊崇他。
15.en: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father's God, and I will exalt him.

15.zh: 耶和华是战士；他的名是耶和华。
15.en: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.

15.zh: 法老的车辆 、 军兵，耶和华已抛在海中；他特选的军长都沉于红海。
15.en: Pharaoh's chariots and his army he has hurled into the sea. The best of Pharaoh's officers are drowned in the Red Sea.

15.zh: 深水淹没他们；他们如同石头坠到深处。
15.en: The deep waters have covered them; they sank to the depths like a stone.

15.zh: 耶和华阿，你的右手施展能力，显出荣耀；耶和华阿，你的右手摔碎仇敌。
15.en: "Your right hand, O Lord , was majestic in power. Your right hand, O Lord , shattered the enemy.

15.zh: 你大发威严，推翻那些起来攻击你的；你发出烈怒如火，烧灭他们像烧碎一样。
15.en: In the greatness of your majesty you threw down those who opposed you. You unleashed your burning anger; it consumed them like stubble.

15.zh: 你发鼻中的气，水便聚起成堆，大水直立如垒，海中的深水凝结。
15.en: By the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up. The surging waters stood firm like a wall; the deep waters congealed in the heart of the sea.

15.zh: 仇敌说：我要追赶，我要追上；我要分掳物，我要在他们身上称我的心愿。我要拔出刀来，亲手杀灭他们。
15.en: "The enemy boasted, 'I will pursue, I will overtake them. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword and my hand will destroy them.'

15.zh: 你叫风一吹，海就把他们淹没；他们如铅沉在大水之中。
15.en: But you blew with your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

15.zh: 耶和华阿，众神之中，谁能像你？谁能像你 ─ 至圣至荣，可颂可畏，施行奇事？
15.en: "Who among the gods is like you, O Lord ? Who is like you- majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?

15.zh: 你伸出右手，地便吞灭他们。
15.en: You stretched out your right hand and the earth swallowed them.

15.zh: 你凭慈爱领了你所赎的百姓；你凭能力引他们到了你的圣所。
15.en: "In your unfailing love you will lead the people you have redeemed. In your strength you will guide them to your holy dwelling.

15.zh: 外邦人听见就发颤；疼痛抓住非利士的居民。
15.en: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the people of Philistia.

15.zh: 那时，以东的族长惊惶，摩押的英雄被战兢抓住，迦南的居民心都消化了。
15.en: The chiefs of Edom will be terrified, the leaders of Moab will be seized with trembling, the people of Canaan will melt away;

15.zh: 惊骇恐惧临到他们。耶和华阿，因你膀臂的大能，他们如石头寂然不动，等候你的百姓过去，等候你所赎的百姓过去。
15.en: terror and dread will fall upon them. By the power of your arm they will be as still as a stone- until your people pass by, O Lord , until the people you bought pass by.

15.zh: 你要将他们领进去，栽于你产业的山上 ─ 耶和华阿，就是你为自己所造的住处；主阿，就是你手所建立的圣所。
15.en: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance- the place, O Lord , you made for your dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, your hands established.

15.zh: 耶和华必作王，直到永永远远！
15.en: The Lord will reign for ever and ever."

15.zh: 法老的马匹 、 车辆，和马兵下到海中，耶和华使海水回流，淹没他们；惟有以色列人在海中走干地。
15.en: When Pharaoh's horses, chariots and horsemen went into the sea, the Lord brought the waters of the sea back over them, but the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.

15.zh: 亚伦的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手里拿著鼓；众妇女也跟他出去拿鼓跳舞。
15.en: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron's sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her, with tambourines and dancing.

15.zh: 米利暗应声说：你们要歌颂耶和华，因他大大战胜，将马和骑马的投在海中。
15.en: Miriam sang to them: "Sing to the Lord , for he is highly exalted. The horse and its rider he has hurled into the sea."

15.zh: 摩西领以色列人从红海往前行，到了书珥的旷野，在旷野走了三天，找不著水。
15.en: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea and they went into the Desert of Shur. For three days they traveled in the desert without finding water.

15.zh: 到了玛拉，不能喝那里的水；因为水苦，所以那地名叫玛拉。
15.en: When they came to Marah, they could not drink its water because it was bitter. (That is why the place is called Marah. )

15.zh: 百姓就向摩西发怨言，说：我们喝甚么呢？
15.en: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What are we to drink?"

15.zh: 摩西呼求耶和华，耶和华指示他一棵树。他把树丢在水里，水就变甜了。耶和华在那里为他们定了律例 、 典章，在那里试验他们；
15.en: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water became sweet. There the Lord made a decree and a law for them, and there he tested them.

15.zh: 又说：你若留意听耶和华 ─ 你神的话，又行我眼中看为正的事，留心听我的诫命，守我一切的律例，我就不将所加与埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因为我 ─ 耶和华是医治你的。
15.en: He said, "If you listen carefully to the voice of the Lord your God and do what is right in his eyes, if you pay attention to his commands and keep all his decrees, I will not bring on you any of the diseases I brought on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord , who heals you."

15.zh: 他们到了以琳，在那里有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树；他们就在那里的水边安营。
15.en: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there near the water.

16.zh: 以色列全会众从以琳起行，在出埃及后第二个月十五日到了以琳和西乃中间 、 汛的旷野。
16.en: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had come out of Egypt.

16.zh: 以色列全会众在旷野向摩西 、 亚伦发怨言，
16.en: In the desert the whole community grumbled against Moses and Aaron.

16.zh: 说：巴不得我们早死在埃及地 、 耶和华的手下；那时我们坐在肉锅旁边，吃得饱足。你们将我们领出来，到这旷野，是要叫这全会众都饿死阿！
16.en: The Israelites said to them, "If only we had died by the Lord 's hand in Egypt! There we sat around pots of meat and ate all the food we wanted, but you have brought us out into this desert to starve this entire assembly to death."

16.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：我要将粮食从天降给你们。百姓可以出去，每天收每天的分，我好试验他们遵不遵我的法度。
16.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test them and see whether they will follow my instructions.

16.zh: 到第六天，他们要把所收进来的预备好了，比每天所收的多一倍。
16.en: On the sixth day they are to prepare what they bring in, and that is to be twice as much as they gather on the other days."

16.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦对以色列众人说：到了晚上，你们要知道是耶和华将你们从埃及地领出来的。
16.en: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, "In the evening you will know that it was the Lord who brought you out of Egypt,

16.zh: 早晨，你们要看见耶和华的荣耀，因为耶和华听见你们向他所发的怨言了。我们算甚么，你们竟向我们发怨言呢？
16.en: and in the morning you will see the glory of the Lord , because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we, that you should grumble against us?"

16.zh: 摩西又说：耶和华晚上必给你们肉吃，早晨必给你们食物得饱；因为你们向耶和华发的怨言，他都听见了。我们算甚么，你们的怨言不是向我们发的，乃是向耶和华发的。
16.en: Moses also said, "You will know that it was the Lord when he gives you meat to eat in the evening and all the bread you want in the morning, because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we? You are not grumbling against us, but against the Lord ."

16.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：你告诉以色列全会众说：你们就近耶和华面前，因为他已经听见你们的怨言了。
16.en: Then Moses told Aaron, "Say to the entire Israelite community, 'Come before the Lord , for he has heard your grumbling.' "

16.zh: 亚伦正对以色列全会众说话的时候，他们向旷野观看，不料，耶和华的荣光在云中显现。
16.en: While Aaron was speaking to the whole Israelite community, they looked toward the desert, and there was the glory of the Lord appearing in the cloud.

16.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
16.en: The Lord said to Moses,

16.zh: 我已经听见以色列人的怨言。你告诉他们说：到黄昏的时候，你们要吃肉，早晨必有食物得饱，你们就知道我是耶和华 ─ 你们的神。
16.en: "I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, 'At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God.' "

16.zh: 到了晚上，有鹌鹑飞来，遮满了营；早晨在营四围的地上有露水。
16.en: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

16.zh: 露水上升之后，不料，野地面上有如白霜的小圆物。
16.en: When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor.

16.zh: 以色列人看见，不知道是甚么，就彼此对问说：这是甚么呢？摩西对他们说：这就是耶和华给你们吃的食物。
16.en: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, "It is the bread the Lord has given you to eat.

16.zh: 耶和华所吩咐的是这样：你们要按著各人的饭量，为帐棚里的人，按著人数收起来，各拿一俄梅珥。
16.en: This is what the Lord has commanded: 'Each one is to gather as much as he needs. Take an omer for each person you have in your tent.' "

16.zh: 以色列人就这样行；有多收的，有少收的。
16.en: The Israelites did as they were told; some gathered much, some little.

16.zh: 及至用俄梅珥量一量，多收的也没有余，少收的也没有缺；各人按著自己的饭量收取。
16.en: And when they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much did not have too much, and he who gathered little did not have too little. Each one gathered as much as he needed.

16.zh: 摩西对他们说：所收的，不许甚么人留到早晨。
16.en: Then Moses said to them, "No one is to keep any of it until morning."

16.zh: 然而他们不听摩西的话，内中有留到早晨的，就生虫变臭了；摩西便向他们发怒。
16.en: However, some of them paid no attention to Moses; they kept part of it until morning, but it was full of maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.

16.zh: 他们每日早晨，按著各人的饭量收取，日头一发热，就消化了。
16.en: Each morning everyone gathered as much as he needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.

16.zh: 到第六天，他们收了双倍的食物，每人两俄梅珥。会众的官长来告诉摩西；
16.en: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much-two omers for each person-and the leaders of the community came and reported this to Moses.

16.zh: 摩西对他们说：耶和华这样说：明天是圣安息日，是向耶和华守的圣安息日。你们要烤的就烤了，要煮的就煮了，所剩下的都留到早晨。
16.en: He said to them, "This is what the Lord commanded: 'Tomorrow is to be a day of rest, a holy Sabbath to the Lord . So bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Save whatever is left and keep it until morning.' "

16.zh: 他们就照摩西的吩咐留到早晨，也不臭，里头也没有虫子。
16.en: So they saved it until morning, as Moses commanded, and it did not stink or get maggots in it.

16.zh: 摩西说：你们今天吃这个罢！因为今天是向耶和华守的安息日；你们在田野必找不著了。
16.en: "Eat it today," Moses said, "because today is a Sabbath to the Lord . You will not find any of it on the ground today.

16.zh: 六天可以收取，第七天乃是安息日，那一天必没有了。
16.en: Six days you are to gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will not be any."

16.zh: 第七天，百姓中有人出去收，甚么也找不著。
16.en: Nevertheless, some of the people went out on the seventh day to gather it, but they found none.

16.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你们不肯守我的诫命和律法，要到几时呢？
16.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "How long will you refuse to keep my commands and my instructions?

16.zh: 你们看！耶和华既将安息日赐给你们，所以第六天他赐给你们两天的食物，第七天各人要住在自己的地方，不许甚么人出去。
16.en: Bear in mind that the Lord has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Everyone is to stay where he is on the seventh day; no one is to go out."

16.zh: 于是百姓第七天安息了。
16.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.

16.zh: 这食物，以色列家叫吗哪；样子像芫荽子，颜色是白的，滋味如同搀蜜的薄饼。
16.en: The people of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.

16.zh: 摩西说：耶和华所吩咐的是这样：要将一满俄梅珥俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一）吗哪留到世世代代，使后人可以看见我当日将你们领出埃及地，在旷野所给你们吃的食物。
16.en: Moses said, "This is what the Lord has commanded: 'Take an omer of manna and keep it for the generations to come, so they can see the bread I gave you to eat in the desert when I brought you out of Egypt.' "

16.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：你拿一个罐子，盛一满俄梅珥吗哪，存在耶和华面前，要留到世世代代。
16.en: So Moses said to Aaron, "Take a jar and put an omer of manna in it. Then place it before the Lord to be kept for the generations to come."

16.zh: 耶和华怎么吩咐摩西，亚伦就怎么行，把吗哪放在法柜前存留。
16.en: As the Lord commanded Moses, Aaron put the manna in front of the Testimony, that it might be kept.

16.zh: 以色列人吃吗哪共四十年，直到进了有人居住之地，就是迦南的境界。
16.en: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land that was settled; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.

16.zh: 俄梅珥就是伊法十分之一。
16.en: (An omer is one tenth of an ephah.)

17.zh: 以色列全会众都遵耶和华的吩咐，按著站口从汛的旷野往前行，在利非订安营。百姓没有水喝，
17.en: The whole Israelite community set out from the Desert of Sin, traveling from place to place as the Lord commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

17.zh: 所以与摩西争闹，说：给我们水喝罢！摩西对他们说：你们为甚么与我争闹？为甚么试探耶和华呢？
17.en: So they quarreled with Moses and said, "Give us water to drink." Moses replied, "Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you put the Lord to the test?"

17.zh: 百姓在那里甚渴，要喝水，就向摩西发怨言，说：你为甚么将我们从埃及领出来，使我们和我们的儿女并牲畜都渴死呢？
17.en: But the people were thirsty for water there, and they grumbled against Moses. They said, "Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?"

17.zh: 摩西就呼求耶和华说：我向这百姓怎样行呢？他们几乎要拿石头打死我。
17.en: Then Moses cried out to the Lord , "What am I to do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me."

17.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你手里拿著你先前击打河水的杖，带领以色列的几个长老，从百姓面前走过去。
