17.en: The Lord answered Moses, "Walk on ahead of the people. Take with you some of the elders of Israel and take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.

17.zh: 我必在何烈的磐石那里，站在你面前。你要击打磐石，从磐石里必有水流出来，使百姓可以喝。摩西就在以色列的长老眼前这样行了。
17.en: I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.

17.zh: 他给那地方起名叫玛撒（就是试探的意思），又叫米利巴（就是争闹的意思）；因以色列人争闹，又因他们试探耶和华，说：耶和华是在我们中间不是？
17.en: And he called the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled and because they tested the Lord saying, "Is the Lord among us or not?"

17.zh: 那时，亚玛力人来在利非订，和以色列人争战。
17.en: The Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.

17.zh: 摩西对约书亚说：你为我们选出人来，出去和亚玛力人争战。明天我手里要拿著神的杖，站在山顶上。
17.en: Moses said to Joshua, "Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on top of the hill with the staff of God in my hands."

17.zh: 于是约书亚照著摩西对他所说的话行，和亚玛力人争战。摩西 、 亚伦，与户珥都上了山顶。
17.en: So Joshua fought the Amalekites as Moses had ordered, and Moses, Aaron and Hur went to the top of the hill.

17.zh: 摩西何时举手，以色列人就得胜，何时垂手，亚玛力人就得胜。
17.en: As long as Moses held up his hands, the Israelites were winning, but whenever he lowered his hands, the Amalekites were winning.

17.zh: 但摩西的手发沉，他们就搬石头来，放在他以下，他就坐在上面。亚伦与户珥扶著他的手，一个在这边，一个在那边，他的手就稳住，直到日落的时候。
17.en: When Moses' hands grew tired, they took a stone and put it under him and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held his hands up-one on one side, one on the other-so that his hands remained steady till sunset.

17.zh: 约书亚用刀杀了亚玛力王和他的百姓。
17.en: So Joshua overcame the Amalekite army with the sword.

17.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：我要将亚玛力的名号从天下全然涂抹了；你要将这话写在书上作纪念，又念给约书亚听。
17.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write this on a scroll as something to be remembered and make sure that Joshua hears it, because I will completely blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven."

17.zh: 摩西筑了一座坛，起名叫耶和华尼西（就是耶和华是我旌旗的意思），
17.en: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord is my Banner.

17.zh: 又说：耶和华已经起了誓，必世世代代和亚玛力人争战。
17.en: He said, "For hands were lifted up to the throne of the Lord . The Lord will be at war against the Amalekites from generation to generation."

18.zh: 摩西的岳父，米甸祭司叶忒罗，听见神为摩西和神的百姓以色列所行的一切事，就是耶和华将以色列从埃及领出来的事，
18.en: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian and father-in-law of Moses, heard of everything God had done for Moses and for his people Israel, and how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.

18.zh: 便带著摩西的妻子西坡拉，就是摩西从前打发回去的，
18.en: After Moses had sent away his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro received her

18.zh: 又带著西坡拉的两个儿子，一个名叫革舜，因为摩西说：我在外邦作了寄居的；
18.en: and her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses said, "I have become an alien in a foreign land";

18.zh: 一个名叫以利以谢因为他说：我父亲的神帮助了我，救我脱离法老的刀。
18.en: and the other was named Eliezer, for he said, "My father's God was my helper; he saved me from the sword of Pharaoh."

18.zh: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗带著摩西的妻子和两个儿子来到神的山，就是摩西在旷野安营的地方。
18.en: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, together with Moses' sons and wife, came to him in the desert, where he was camped near the mountain of God.

18.zh: 他对摩西说：我是你岳父叶忒罗，带著你的妻子和两个儿子来到你这里。
18.en: Jethro had sent word to him, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons."

18.zh: 摩西迎接他的岳父，向他下拜，与他亲嘴，彼此问安，都进了帐棚。
18.en: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and then went into the tent.

18.zh: 摩西将耶和华为以色列的缘故向法老和埃及人所行的一切事，以及路上所遭遇的一切艰难，并耶和华怎样搭救他们，都述说与他岳父听。
18.en: Moses told his father-in- law about everything the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel's sake and about all the hardships they had met along the way and how the Lord had saved them.

18.zh: 叶忒罗因耶和华待以色列的一切好处，就是拯救他们脱离埃及人的手，便甚欢喜。
18.en: Jethro was delighted to hear about all the good things the Lord had done for Israel in rescuing them from the hand of the Egyptians.

18.zh: 叶忒罗说：耶和华是应当称颂的；他救了你们脱离埃及人和法老的手，将这百姓从埃及人的手下救出来。
18.en: He said, "Praise be to the Lord , who rescued you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who rescued the people from the hand of the Egyptians.

18.zh: 我现今在埃及人向这百姓发狂傲的事上得知，耶和华比万神都大。
18.en: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all other gods, for he did this to those who had treated Israel arrogantly."

18.zh: 摩西的岳父叶忒罗把燔祭和平安祭献给神。亚伦和以色列的众长老都来了，与摩西的岳父在神面前吃饭。
18.en: Then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and other sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law in the presence of God.

18.zh: 第二天，摩西坐著审判百姓，百姓从早到晚都站在摩西的左右。
18.en: The next day Moses took his seat to serve as judge for the people, and they stood around him from morning till evening.

18.zh: 摩西的岳父看见他向百姓所做的一切事，就说：你向百姓做的是甚么事呢？你为甚么独自坐著，众百姓从早到晚都站在你的左右呢？
18.en: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he said, "What is this you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit as judge, while all these people stand around you from morning till evening?"

18.zh: 摩西对岳父说：这是因百姓到我这里来求问神。
18.en: Moses answered him, "Because the people come to me to seek God's will.

18.zh: 他们有事的时候就到我这里来，我便在两造之间施行审判；我又叫他们知道神的律例和法度。
18.en: Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me, and I decide between the parties and inform them of God's decrees and laws."

18.zh: 摩西的岳父说：你这做的不好。
18.en: Moses' father-in-law replied, "What you are doing is not good.

18.zh: 你和这些百姓必都疲惫；因为这事太重，你独自一人办理不了。
18.en: You and these people who come to you will only wear yourselves out. The work is too heavy for you; you cannot handle it alone.

18.zh: 现在你要听我的话。我为你出个主意，愿神与你同在。你要替百姓到神面前，将案件奏告神；
18.en: Listen now to me and I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people's representative before God and bring their disputes to him.

18.zh: 又要将律例和法度教训他们，指示他们当行的道，当做的事；
18.en: Teach them the decrees and laws, and show them the way to live and the duties they are to perform.

18.zh: 并要从百姓中拣选有才能的人，就是敬畏神 、 诚实无妄 、 恨不义之财的人，派他们作千夫长 、 百夫长 、 五十夫长 、 十夫长，管理百姓，
18.en: But select capable men from all the people-men who fear God, trustworthy men who hate dishonest gain-and appoint them as officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

18.zh: 叫他们随时审判百姓，大事都要呈到你这里，小事他们自己可以审判。这样，你就轻省些，他们也可以同当此任。
18.en: Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will make your load lighter, because they will share it with you.

18.zh: 你若这样行，神也这样吩咐你，你就能受得住，这百姓也都平平安安归回他们的住处。
18.en: If you do this and God so commands, you will be able to stand the strain, and all these people will go home satisfied."

18.zh: 于是，摩西听从他岳父的话，按著他所说的去行。
18.en: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.

18.zh: 摩西从以色列人中拣选了有才能的人，立他们为百姓的首领，作千夫长 、 百夫长 、 五十夫长 、 十夫长。
18.en: He chose capable men from all Israel and made them leaders of the people, officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

18.zh: 他们随时审判百姓，有难断的案件就呈到摩西那里，但各样小事他们自己审判。
18.en: They served as judges for the people at all times. The difficult cases they brought to Moses, but the simple ones they decided themselves.

18.zh: 此后，摩西让他的岳父去，他就往本地去了。
18.en: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own country.

19.zh: 以色列人出埃及地以后，满了三个月的那一天，就来到西乃的旷野。
19.en: In the third month after the Israelites left Egypt-on the very day-they came to the Desert of Sinai.

19.zh: 他们离了利非订，来到西乃的旷野，就在那里的山下安营。
19.en: "I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

19.zh: 摩西到神那里，耶和华从山上呼唤他说：你要这样告诉雅各家，晓谕以色列人说：
19.en: "You shall have no other gods before me.

19.zh: 我向埃及人所行的事，你们都看见了，且看见我如鹰将你们背在翅膀上，带来归我。
19.en: "You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

19.zh: 如今你们若实在听从我的话，遵守我的约，就要在万民中作属我的子民，因为全地都是我的。
19.en: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

19.zh: 你们要归我作祭司的国度，为圣洁的国民。这些话你要告诉以色列人。
19.en: but showing love to a thousand [generations] of those who love me and keep my commandments.

19.zh: 摩西去召了民间的长老来，将耶和华所吩咐他的话都在他们面前陈明。
19.en: "You shall not misuse the name of the Lord your God, for the Lord will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

19.zh: 百姓都同声回答说：凡耶和华所说的，我们都要遵行。摩西就将百姓的话回覆耶和华。
19.en: "Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

19.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：我要在密云中临到你那里，叫百姓在我与你说话的时候可以听见，也可以永远信你了。于是，摩西将百姓的话奏告耶和华。
19.en: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

19.zh: 耶和华又对摩西说：你往百姓那里去，叫他们今天明天自洁，又叫他们洗衣服。
19.en: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your animals, nor the alien within your gates.

19.zh: 到第三天要预备好了，因为第三天耶和华要在众百姓眼前降临在西乃山上。
19.en: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.

19.zh: 你要在山的四围给百姓定界限，说：你们当谨慎，不可上山去，也不可摸山的边界；凡摸这山的，必要治死他。
19.en: "Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

19.zh: 不可用手摸他，必用石头打死，或用箭射透；无论是人是牲畜，都不得活。到角声拖长的时候，他们才可到山根来。
19.en: "You shall not murder.

19.zh: 摩西下山往百姓那里去，叫他们自洁，他们就洗衣服。
19.en: "You shall not commit adultery.

19.zh: 他对百姓说：到第三天要预备好了。不可亲近女人。
19.en: "You shall not steal.

19.zh: 到了第三天早晨，在山上有雷轰 、 闪电，和密云，并且角声甚大，营中的百姓尽都发颤。
19.en: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

19.zh: 摩西率领百姓出营迎接神，都站在山下。
19.en: "You shall not covet your neighbor's house. You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, or his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

19.zh: 西乃全山冒烟，因为耶和华在火中降于山上。山的烟气上腾，如烧窑一般，遍山大大的震动。
19.en: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance

19.zh: 角声渐渐的高而又高，摩西就说话，神有声音答应他。
19.en: and said to Moses, "Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die."

19.zh: 耶和华降临在西乃山顶上，耶和华召摩西上山顶，摩西就上去。
19.en: Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning."

19.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你下去嘱咐百姓，不可闯过来到我面前观看，恐怕他们有多人死亡；
19.en: The people remained at a distance, while Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.

19.zh: 又叫亲近我的祭司自洁，恐怕我忽然出来击杀他们。
19.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites this: 'You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:

19.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：百姓不能上西乃山，因为你已经嘱咐我们说：要在山的四围定界限，叫山成圣。
19.en: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.

19.zh: 耶和华对他说：下去罢，你要和亚伦一同上来；只是祭司和百姓不可闯过来上到我面前，恐怕我忽然出来击杀他们。
19.en: " 'Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.

19.zh: 于是摩西下到百姓那里告诉他们。
19.en: If you make an altar of stones for me, do not build it with dressed stones, for you will defile it if you use a tool on it.
And do not go up to my altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.'

20.zh: 神吩咐这一切的话说：
我是耶和华 ─ 你的神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。
除了我以外，你不可有别的神。
不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可做甚么形像彷佛上天 、 下地，和地底下 、 水中的百物。
不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉他，因为我耶和华 ─ 你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代；
爱我 、 守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。
不可妄称耶和华 ─ 你神的名；因为妄称耶和华名的，耶和华必不以他为无罪。
当记念安息日，守为圣日。
六日要劳碌做你一切的工，
但第七日是向耶和华 ─ 你神当守的安息日。这一日你和你的儿女 、 仆婢 、 牲畜，并你城里寄居的客旅，无论何工都不可做；
因为六日之内，耶和华造天 、 地 、 海，和其中的万物，第七日便安息，所以耶和华赐福与安息日，定为圣日。
当孝敬父母，使你的日子在耶和华 ─ 你神所赐你的地上得以长久。
不可杀人。
不可奸淫。
不可偷盗。
不可作假见证陷害人。
不可贪恋人的房屋；也不可贪恋人的妻子 、 仆婢 、 牛驴，并他一切所有的。
众百姓见雷轰 、 闪电 、 角声 、 山上冒烟，就都发颤，远远的站立，
对摩西说：求你和我们说话，我们必听；不要神和我们说话，恐怕我们死亡。
摩西对百姓说：不要惧怕；因为神降临是要试验你们，叫你们时常敬畏他，不致犯罪。
于是百姓远远地站立；摩西就挨近神所在的幽暗之中。
耶和华对摩西说：你要向以色列人这样说：你们自己看见我从天上和你们说话了。
你们不可做甚么神像与我相配，不可为自己做金银的神像。
你要为我筑土坛，在上面以牛羊献为燔祭和平安祭。凡记下我名的地方，我必到那里赐福给你。
你若为我筑一座石坛，不可用凿成的石头，因你在上头一动家具，就把坛污秽了。
你上我的坛，不可用台阶，免得露出你的下体来。

21.zh: 你在百姓面前所要立的典章是这样：
21.en: "These are the laws you are to setbefore them:

21.zh: 你若买希伯来人作奴仆，他必服事你六年；第七年他可以自由，白白的出去。
21.en: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free, without paying anything.

21.zh: 他若孤身来就可以孤身去；他若有妻，他的妻就可以同他出去。
21.en: If he comes alone, he is to go free alone; but if he has a wife when he comes, she is to go with him.

21.zh: 他主人若给他妻子，妻子给他生了儿子或女儿，妻子和儿女要归主人，他要独自出去。
21.en: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.

21.zh: 倘或奴仆明说：我爱我的主人和我的妻子儿女，不愿意自由出去。
21.en: "But if the servant declares, 'I love my master and my wife and children and do not want to go free,'

21.zh: 他的主人就要带他到审判官（审判官或作：神；下同）那里，又要带他到门前，靠近门框，用锥子穿他的耳朵，他就永远服事主人。
21.en: then his master must take him before the judges. He shall take him to the door or the doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he will be his servant for life.

21.zh: 人若卖女儿作婢女，婢女不可像男仆那样出去。
21.en: "If a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as menservants do.

21.zh: 主人选定他归自己，若不喜欢他，就要许他赎身；主人既然用诡诈待他，就没有权柄卖给外邦人。
21.en: If she does not please the master who has selected her for himself, he must let her be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, because he has broken faith with her.

21.zh: 主人若选定他给自己的儿子，就当待他如同女儿。
21.en: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.

21.zh: 若另娶一个，那女子的吃食 、 衣服，并好合的事，仍不可减少。
21.en: If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights.

21.zh: 若不向他行这三样，他就可以不用钱赎，白白的出去。
21.en: If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money.

21.zh: 打人以致打死的，必要把他治死。
21.en: "Anyone who strikes a man and kills him shall surely be put to death.

21.zh: 人若不是埋伏著杀人，乃是神交在他手中，我就设下一个地方，他可以往那里逃跑。
21.en: However, if he does not do it intentionally, but God lets it happen, he is to flee to a place I will designate.

21.zh: 人若任意用诡计杀了他的邻舍，就是逃到我的坛那里，也当捉去把他治死。
21.en: But if a man schemes and kills another man deliberately, take him away from my altar and put him to death.

21.zh: 打父母的，必要把他治死。
21.en: "Anyone who attacks his father or his mother must be put to death.

21.zh: 拐带人口，或是把人卖了，或是留在他手下，必要把他治死。
21.en: "Anyone who kidnaps another and either sells him or still has him when he is caught must be put to death.

21.zh: 咒骂父母的，必要把他治死。
21.en: "Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.

21.zh: 人若彼此相争，这个用石头或是拳头打那个，尚且不至于死，不过躺卧在床，
21.en: "If men quarrel and one hits the other with a stone or with his fist and he does not die but is confined to bed,

21.zh: 若再能起来扶杖而出，那打他的可算无罪；但要将他耽误的工夫用钱赔补，并要将他全然医好。
21.en: the one who struck the blow will not be held responsible if the other gets up and walks around outside with his staff; however, he must pay the injured man for the loss of his time and see that he is completely healed.

21.zh: 人若用棍子打奴仆或婢女，立时死在他的手下，他必要受刑。
21.en: "If a man beats his male or female slave with a rod and the slave dies as a direct result, he must be punished,

21.zh: 若过一两天才死，就可以不受刑，因为是用钱买的。
21.en: but he is not to be punished if the slave gets up after a day or two, since the slave is his property.

21.zh: 人若彼此争斗，伤害有孕的妇人，甚至坠胎，随后却无别害，那伤害他的，总要按妇人的丈夫所要的，照审判官所断的，受罚。
21.en: "If men who are fighting hit a pregnant woman and she gives birth prematurely but there is no serious injury, the offender must be fined whatever the woman's husband demands and the court allows.

21.zh: 若有别害，就要以命偿命，
21.en: But if there is serious injury, you are to take life for life,

21.zh: 以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚，
21.en: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

21.zh: 以烙还烙，以伤还伤，以打还打。
21.en: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.

21.zh: 人若打坏了他奴仆或是婢女的一只眼，就要因他的眼放他去得以自由。
21.en: "If a man hits a manservant or maidservant in the eye and destroys it, he must let the servant go free to compensate for the eye.

21.zh: 若打掉了他奴仆或是婢女的一个牙，就要因他的牙放他去得以自由。
21.en: And if he knocks out the tooth of a manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free to compensate for the tooth.

21.zh: 牛若触死男人或是女人，总要用石头打死那牛，却不可吃他的肉；牛的主人可算无罪。
21.en: "If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull must be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.

21.zh: 倘若那牛素来是触人的，有人报告了牛主，他竟不把牛拴著，以致把男人或是女人触死，就要用石头打死那牛，牛主也必治死。
21.en: If, however, the bull has had the habit of goring and the owner has been warned but has not kept it penned up and it kills a man or woman, the bull must be stoned and the owner also must be put to death.

21.zh: 若罚他赎命的价银，他必照所罚的赎他的命。
21.en: However, if payment is demanded of him, he may redeem his life by paying whatever is demanded.

21.zh: 牛无论触了人的儿子或是女儿，必照这例办理。
21.en: This law also applies if the bull gores a son or daughter.

21.zh: 牛若触了奴仆或是婢女，必将银子三十舍客勒给他们的主人，也要用石头把牛打死。
21.en: If the bull gores a male or female slave, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of the slave, and the bull must be stoned.

21.zh: 人若敞著井口，或挖井不遮盖，有牛或驴掉在里头，
21.en: "If a man uncovers a pit or digs one and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it,

21.zh: 井主要拿钱赔还本主人，死牲畜要归自己。
21.en: the owner of the pit must pay for the loss; he must pay its owner, and the dead animal will be his.

21.zh: 这人的牛若伤了那人的牛，以至于死，他们要卖了活牛，平分价值，也要平分死牛。
21.en: "If a man's bull injures the bull of another and it dies, they are to sell the live one and divide both the money and the dead animal equally.

21.zh: 人若知道这牛素来是触人的，主人竟不把牛拴著，他必要以牛还牛，死牛要归自己。
21.en: However, if it was known that the bull had the habit of goring, yet the owner did not keep it penned up, the owner must pay, animal for animal, and the dead animal will be his.

22.zh: 人若偷牛或羊，无论是宰了，是卖了，他就要以五牛赔一牛，四羊赔一羊。
22.en: "If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it, he must pay back five head of cattle for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.

22.zh: 人若遇见贼挖窟窿，把贼打了，以至于死，就不能为他有流血的罪。
22.en: "If a thief is caught breaking in and is struck so that he dies, the defender is not guilty of bloodshed;

22.zh: 若太阳已经出来，就为他有流血的罪。贼若被拿，总要赔还。若他一无所有，就要被卖，顶他所偷的物。
22.en: but if it happens after sunrise, he is guilty of bloodshed. "A thief must certainly make restitution, but if he has nothing, he must be sold to pay for his theft.

22.zh: 若他所偷的，或牛，或驴，或羊，仍在他手下存活，他就要加倍赔还。
22.en: "If the stolen animal is found alive in his possession-whether ox or donkey or sheep-he must pay back double.

22.zh: 人若在田间或在葡萄园里放牲畜，任凭牲畜上别人的田里去吃，就必拿自己田间上好的和葡萄园上好的赔还。
22.en: "If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and lets them stray and they graze in another man's field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.

22.zh: 若点火焚烧荆棘，以致将别人堆积的禾捆，站著的禾稼，或是田园，都烧尽了，那点火的必要赔还。
22.en: "If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.

22.zh: 人若将银钱或家具交付邻舍看守，这物从那人的家被偷去，若把贼找到了，贼要加倍赔还；
22.en: "If a man gives his neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor's house, the thief, if he is caught, must pay back double.

22.zh: 若找不到贼，那家主必就近审判官，要看看他拿了原主的物件没有。
22.en: But if the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has laid his hands on the other man's property.

22.zh: 两个人的案件，无论是为甚么过犯，或是为牛，为驴，为羊，为衣裳，或是为甚么失掉之物，有一人说：这是我的，两造就要将案件禀告审判官，审判官定谁有罪，谁就要加倍赔还。
22.en: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, 'This is mine,' both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.

22.zh: 人若将驴，或牛，或羊，或别的牲畜，交付邻舍看守，牲畜或死，或受伤，或被赶去，无人看见，
22.en: "If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep or any other animal to his neighbor for safekeeping and it dies or is injured or is taken away while no one is looking,

22.zh: 那看守的人要凭著耶和华起誓，手里未曾拿邻舍的物，本主就要罢休，看守的人不必赔还。
22.en: the issue between them will be settled by the taking of an oath before the Lord that the neighbor did not lay hands on the other person's property. The owner is to accept this, and no restitution is required.

22.zh: 牲畜若从看守的那里被偷去，他就要赔还本主；
22.en: But if the animal was stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.

22.zh: 若被野兽撕碎，看守的要带来当作证据，所撕的不必赔还。
22.en: If it was torn to pieces by a wild animal, he shall bring in the remains as evidence and he will not be required to pay for the torn animal.

22.zh: 人若向邻舍借甚么，所借的或受伤，或死，本主没有同在一处，借的人总要赔还；
22.en: "If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while the owner is not present, he must make restitution.

22.zh: 若本主同在一处，他就不必赔还；若是雇的，也不必赔还，本是为雇价来的。
22.en: But if the owner is with the animal, the borrower will not have to pay. If the animal was hired, the money paid for the hire covers the loss.

22.zh: 人若引诱没有受聘的处女，与他行淫，他总要交出聘礼，娶他为妻。
22.en: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged to be married and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price, and she shall be his wife.

22.zh: 若女子的父亲决不肯将女子给他，他就要按处女的聘礼，交出钱来。
22.en: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he must still pay the bride-price for virgins.

22.zh: 行邪术的女人，不可容他存活。
22.en: "Do not allow a sorceress to live.

22.zh: 凡与兽淫合的，总要把他治死。
22.en: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal must be put to death.

22.zh: 祭祀别神，不单单祭祀耶和华的，那人必要灭绝。
22.en: "Whoever sacrifices to any god other than the Lord must be destroyed.

22.zh: 不可亏负寄居的，也不可欺压他，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
22.en: "Do not mistreat an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in Egypt.

22.zh: 不可苦待寡妇和孤儿；
22.en: "Do not take advantage of a widow or an orphan.

22.zh: 若是苦待他们一点，他们向我一哀求，我总要听他们的哀声，
22.en: If you do and they cry out to me, I will certainly hear their cry.

22.zh: 并要发烈怒，用刀杀你们，使你们的妻子为寡妇，儿女为孤儿。
22.en: My anger will be aroused, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives will become widows and your children fatherless.

22.zh: 我民中有贫穷人与你同住，你若借钱给他，不可如放债的向他取利。
22.en: "If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not be like a moneylender; charge him no interest.

22.zh: 你即或拿邻舍的衣服作当头，必在日落以先归还他；
22.en: If you take your neighbor's cloak as a pledge, return it to him by sunset,

22.zh: 因他只有这一件当盖头，是他盖身的衣服，若是没有，他拿甚么睡觉呢？他哀求我，我就应允，因为我是有恩惠的。
22.en: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? When he cries out to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

22.zh: 不可毁谤神；也不可毁谤你百姓的官长。
22.en: "Do not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

22.zh: 你要从你庄稼中的谷和酒醡中滴出来的酒拿来献上，不可迟延。你要将头生的儿子归给我。
22.en: "Do not hold back offerings from your granaries or your vats. "You must give me the firstborn of your sons.

22.zh: 你牛羊头生的，也要这样；七天当跟著母，第八天要归给我。
22.en: Do the same with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but give them to me on the eighth day.

22.zh: 你要在我面前为圣洁的人。因此，田间被野兽撕裂牲畜的肉，你们不可吃，要丢给狗吃。
22.en: "You are to be my holy people. So do not eat the meat of an animal torn by wild beasts; throw it to the dogs.

23.zh: 不可随伙布散谣言；不可与恶人连手妄作见证。
23.en: "Do not spread false reports. Do not help a wicked man by being a malicious witness.

23.zh: 不可随众行恶；不可在争讼的事上随众偏行，作见证屈枉正直；
23.en: "Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you give testimony in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd,

23.zh: 也不可在争讼的事上偏护穷人。
23.en: and do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.

23.zh: 若遇见你仇敌的牛或驴失迷了路，总要牵回来交给他。
23.en: "If you come across your enemy's ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to take it back to him.

23.zh: 若看见恨你人的驴压卧在重驮之下，不可走开，务要和驴主一同抬开重驮。
23.en: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen down under its load, do not leave it there; be sure you help him with it.

23.zh: 不可在穷人争讼的事上屈枉正直。
23.en: "Do not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

23.zh: 当远离虚假的事。不可杀无辜和有义的人，因我必不以恶人为义。
23.en: Have nothing to do with a false charge and do not put an innocent or honest person to death, for I will not acquit the guilty.

23.zh: 不可受贿赂；因为贿赂能叫明眼人变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。
23.en: "Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.

23.zh: 不可欺压寄居的；因为你们在埃及地作过寄居的，知道寄居的心。
23.en: "Do not oppress an alien; you yourselves know how it feels to be aliens, because you were aliens in Egypt.

23.zh: 六年你要耕种田地，收藏土产，
23.en: "For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,

23.zh: 只是第七年要叫地歇息，不耕不种，使你民中的穷人有吃的；他们所剩下的，野兽可以吃。你的葡萄园和橄榄园也要照样办理。
23.en: but during the seventh year let the land lie unplowed and unused. Then the poor among your people may get food from it, and the wild animals may eat what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

23.zh: 六日你要做工，第七日要安息，使牛 、 驴可以歇息，并使你婢女的儿子和寄居的都可以舒畅。
23.en: "Six days do your work, but on the seventh day do not work, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the slave born in your household, and the alien as well, may be refreshed.

23.zh: 凡我对你们说的话，你们要谨守。别神的名，你不可题，也不可从你口中传说。
23.en: "Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.

23.zh: 一年三次，你要向我守节。
23.en: "Three times a year you are to celebrate a festival to me.

23.zh: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期，吃无酵饼七天。谁也不可空手朝见我，因为你是这月出了埃及。
23.en: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

23.zh: 又要守收割节，所收的是你田间所种 、 劳碌得来初熟之物。并在年底收藏，要守收藏节。
23.en: "Celebrate the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the crops you sow in your field. "Celebrate the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the field.

23.zh: 一切的男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华。
23.en: "Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord .

23.zh: 不可将我祭牲的血和有酵的饼一同献上；也不可将我节上祭牲的脂油留到早晨。
23.en: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast. "The fat of my festival offerings must not be kept until morning.

23.zh: 地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华 ─ 你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
23.en: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

23.zh: 看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保护你，领你到我所预备的地方去。
23.en: "See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

23.zh: 他是奉我名来的；你们要在他面前谨慎，听从他的话，不可惹（惹或作：违背）他，因为他必不赦免你们的过犯。
23.en: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.

23.zh: 你若实在听从他的话，照著我一切所说的去行，我就向你的仇敌作仇敌，向你的敌人作敌人。
23.en: If you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and will oppose those who oppose you.

23.zh: 我的使者要在你前面行，领你到亚摩利人 、 赫人 、 比利洗人 、 迦南人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人那里去，我必将他们剪除。
23.en: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.

23.zh: 你不可跪拜他们的神，不可事奉他，也不可效法他们的行为，却要把神像尽行拆毁，打碎他们的柱像。
23.en: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.

23.zh: 你们要事奉耶和华 ─ 你们的神，他必赐福与你的粮与你的水，也必从你们中间除去疾病。
23.en: Worship the Lord your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,

23.zh: 你境内必没有坠胎的，不生产的。我要使你满了你年日的数目。
23.en: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.

23.zh: 凡你所到的地方，我要使那里的众民在你面前惊骇，扰乱，又要使你一切仇敌转背逃跑。
23.en: "I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.

23.zh: 我要打发黄蜂飞在你前面，把希未人 、 迦南人 、 赫人撵出去。
23.en: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

23.zh: 我不在一年之内将他们从你面前撵出去，恐怕地成为荒凉，野地的兽多起来害你。
23.en: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.

23.zh: 我要渐渐地将他们从你面前撵出去，等到你的人数加多，承受那地为业。
23.en: Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land.

23.zh: 我要定你的境界，从红海直到非利士海，又从旷野直到大河。我要将那地的居民交在你手中，你要将他们从你面前撵出去。
23.en: "I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River. I will hand over to you the people who live in the land and you will drive them out before you.

23.zh: 不可和他们并他们的神立约。
23.en: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.

23.zh: 他们不可住在你的地上，恐怕他们使你得罪我。你若事奉他们的神，这必成为你的网罗。
23.en: Do not let them live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you."

24.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你和亚伦 、 拿答 、 亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都要上到我这里来，远远的下拜。
24.en: Then he said to Moses, "Come up to the Lord , you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,

24.zh: 惟独你可以亲近耶和华；他们却不可亲近；百姓也不可和你一同上来。
24.en: but Moses alone is to approach the Lord ; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him."

24.zh: 摩西下山，将耶和华的命令典章都述说与百姓听。众百姓齐声说：耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。
24.en: When Moses went and told the people all the Lord 's words and laws, they responded with one voice, "Everything the Lord has said we will do."

24.zh: 摩西将耶和华的命令都写上。清早起来，在山下筑一座坛，按以色列十二支派立十二根柱子，
24.en: Moses then wrote down everything the Lord had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.

24.zh: 又打发以色列人中的少年人去献燔祭，又向耶和华献牛为平安祭。
24.en: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the Lord .

24.zh: 摩西将血一半盛在盆中，一半洒在坛上；
24.en: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.

24.zh: 又将约书念给百姓听。他们说：耶和华所吩咐的，我们都必遵行。
24.en: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, "We will do everything the Lord has said; we will obey."

24.zh: 摩西将血洒在百姓身上，说：你看！这是立约的血，是耶和华按这一切话与你们立约的凭据。
24.en: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, "This is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words."

24.zh: 摩西 、 亚伦 、 拿答 、 亚比户，并以色列长老中的七十人，都上了山。
24.en: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up

24.zh: 他们看见以色列的神，他脚下彷佛有平铺的蓝宝石，如同天色明净。
24.en: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of sapphire, clear as the sky itself.

24.zh: 他的手不加害在以色列的尊者身上。他们观看神；他们又吃又喝。
24.en: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.

24.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你上山到我这里来，住在这里，我要将石版并我所写的律法和诫命赐给你，使你可以教训百姓。
24.en: The Lord said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commands I have written for their instruction."

24.zh: 摩西和他的帮手约书亚起来，上了神的山。
24.en: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.

24.zh: 摩西对长老说：你们在这里等著，等到我们再回来，有亚伦 、 户珥与你们同在。凡有争讼的，都可以就近他们去。
24.en: He said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them."

24.zh: 摩西上山，有云彩把山遮盖。
24.en: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

24.zh: 耶和华的荣耀停于西乃山；云彩遮盖山六天，第七天他从云中召摩西。
24.en: and the glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the Lord called to Moses from within the cloud.

24.zh: 耶和华的荣耀在山顶上，在以色列人眼前，形状如烈火。
24.en: To the Israelites the glory of the Lord looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.

24.zh: 摩西进入云中上山，在山上四十昼夜。
24.en: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

25.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
25.en: The Lord said to Moses,

25.zh: 你告诉以色列人当为我送礼物来；凡甘心乐意的，你们就可以收下归我。
25.en: "Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from each man whose heart prompts him to give.

25.zh: 所要收的礼物：就是金 、 银 、 铜，
25.en: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;

25.zh: 蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，
25.en: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

25.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，
25.en: ram skins dyed red and hides of sea cows ; acacia wood;

25.zh: 点灯的油并做膏油和香的香料，
25.en: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

25.zh: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上。
25.en: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

25.zh: 又当为我造圣所，使我可以住在他们中间。
25.en: "Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

25.zh: 制造帐幕和其中的一切器具都要照我所指示你的样式。
25.en: Make this tabernacle and all its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.

25.zh: 要用皂荚木做一柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。
25.en: "Have them make a chest of acacia wood-two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

25.zh: 要里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。
25.en: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

25.zh: 也要铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上；这边两环，那边两环。
25.en: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

25.zh: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。
25.en: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

25.zh: 要把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。
25.en: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the chest to carry it.

25.zh: 这杠要常在柜的环内，不可抽出来。
25.en: The poles are to remain in the rings of this ark; they are not to be removed.

25.zh: 必将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。
25.en: Then put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

25.zh: 要用精金做施恩座（施恩：或作蔽罪；下同），长二肘半，宽一肘半。
25.en: "Make an atonement cover of pure gold- two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

25.zh: 要用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头。
25.en: And make two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

25.zh: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯要接连一块，在施恩座的两头。
25.en: Make one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; make the cherubim of one piece with the cover, at the two ends.

25.zh: 二基路伯要高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座。基路伯要脸对脸，朝著施恩座。
25.en: The cherubim are to have their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the cover.

25.zh: 要将施恩座安在柜的上边，又将我所要赐给你的法版放在柜里。
25.en: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

25.zh: 我要在那里与你相会，又要从法柜施恩座上二基路伯中间，和你说我所要吩咐你传给以色列人的一切事。
25.en: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.

25.zh: 要用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半。
25.en: "Make a table of acacia wood -two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

25.zh: 要包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。
25.en: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

25.zh: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶著金牙边。
25.en: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

25.zh: 要做四个金环，安在桌子的四角上，就是桌子四脚上的四角。
25.en: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners, where the four legs are.

25.zh: 安环子的地方要挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。
25.en: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

25.zh: 要用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子。
25.en: Make the poles of acacia wood, overlay them with gold and carry the table with them.

25.zh: 要做桌子上的盘子 、 调羹，并奠酒的爵和瓶；这都要用精金制作。
25.en: And make its plates and dishes of pure gold, as well as its pitchers and bowls for the pouring out of offerings.

25.zh: 又要在桌子上，在我面前，常摆陈设饼。
25.en: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.

25.zh: 要用精金做一个灯台。灯台的座和干与杯 、 球 、 花，都要接连一块锤出来。
25.en: "Make a lampstand of pure gold and hammer it out, base and shaft; its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms shall be of one piece with it.

25.zh: 灯台两旁要杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。
25.en: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand-three on one side and three on the other.

25.zh: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。
25.en: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

25.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球，有花。
25.en: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

25.zh: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球与枝子接连一块。灯台出的六个枝子都是如此。
25.en: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair-six branches in all.

25.zh: 球和枝子要接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。
25.en: The buds and branches shall all be of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

25.zh: 要做灯台的七个灯盏。祭司要点这灯，使灯光对照。
25.en: "Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.

25.zh: 灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘也是要精金的。
25.en: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.

25.zh: 做灯台和这一切的器具要用精金一他连得。
25.en: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.

25.zh: 要谨慎做这些物件，都要照著在山上指示你的样式。
25.en: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

26.zh: 你要用十幅幔子做帐幕。这些幔子要用撚的细麻和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线制造，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
26.en: "Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.

26.zh: 每幅幔子要长二十八肘，宽四肘，幔子都要一样的尺寸。
26.en: All the curtains are to be the same size-twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

26.zh: 这五幅幔子要幅幅相连；那五幅幔子也要幅幅相连。
26.en: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.

26.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做蓝色的钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也要照样做。
26.en: Make loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same with the end curtain in the other set.

26.zh: 要在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都要两两相对。
26.en: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

26.zh: 又要做五十个金钩，用钩使幔子相连，这才成了一个帐幕。
26.en: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.

26.zh: 你要用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
26.en: "Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle-eleven altogether.

26.zh: 每幅幔子要长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都要一样的尺寸。
26.en: All eleven curtains are to be the same size-thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

26.zh: 要把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅，这第六幅幔子要在罩棚的前面折上去。
26.en: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.

26.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上要做五十个钮扣；在那相连的幔子末幅边上也做五十个钮扣。
26.en: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

26.zh: 又要做五十个铜钩，钩在钮扣中，使罩棚连成一个。
26.en: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.

26.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余那垂下来的半幅幔子，要垂在帐幕的后头。
26.en: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.

26.zh: 罩棚的幔子所余长的，这边一肘，那边一肘，要垂在帐幕的两旁，遮盖帐幕。
26.en: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.

26.zh: 又要用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖；再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。
26.en: Make for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of hides of sea cows.

26.zh: 你要用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。
26.en: "Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

26.zh: 每块要长十肘，宽一肘半；
26.en: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

26.zh: 每块必有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都要这样做。
26.en: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

26.zh: 帐幕的南面要做板二十块。
26.en: Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

26.zh: 在这二十块板底下要做四十个带卯的银座，两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。
26.en: and make forty silver bases to go under them-two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

26.zh: 帐幕第二面，就是北面，也要做板二十块
26.en: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames

26.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。
26.en: and forty silver bases-two under each frame.

26.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，要做板六块。
26.en: Make six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

26.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角要做板两块。
26.en: and make two frames for the corners at the far end.

26.zh: 板的下半截要双的，上半截要整的，直顶到第一个环子；两块都要这样做两个拐角。
26.en: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top, and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.

26.zh: 必有八块板和十六个带卯的银座；这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。
26.en: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases-two under each frame.

26.zh: 你要用皂荚木做闩：为帐幕这面的板做五闩，
26.en: "Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

26.zh: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩。
26.en: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

26.zh: 板腰间的中闩要从这一头通到那一头。
26.en: The center crossbar is to extend from end to end at the middle of the frames.

26.zh: 板要用金子包裹，又要做板上的金环套闩；闩也要用金子包裹。
26.en: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

26.zh: 要照著在山上指示你的样式立起帐幕。
26.en: "Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.

26.zh: 你要用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和撚的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
26.en: "Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled craftsman.

26.zh: 要把幔子挂在四根包金的皂荚木柱子上，柱子上当有金钩，柱子安在四个带卯的银座上。
26.en: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

26.zh: 要使幔子垂在钩子下，把法柜抬进幔子内；这幔子要将圣所和至圣所隔开。
26.en: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

26.zh: 又要把施恩座安在至圣所内的法柜上，
26.en: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.

26.zh: 把桌子安在幔子外帐幕的北面；把灯台安在帐幕的南面，彼此相对。
26.en: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.

26.zh: 你要拿蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和撚的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘。
26.en: "For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-the work of an embroiderer.

26.zh: 要用皂荚木为帘子做五根柱子，用金子包裹。柱子上当有金钩；又要为柱子用铜铸造五个带卯的座。
26.en: Make gold hooks for this curtain and five posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold. And cast five bronze bases for them.

27.zh: 你要用皂荚木做坛。这坛要四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘。
27.en: "Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

27.zh: 要在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。
27.en: Make a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar are of one piece, and overlay the altar with bronze.

27.zh: 要做盆，收去坛上的灰，又做铲子 、 盘子 、 肉锸子 、 火鼎；坛上一切的器具都用铜做。
27.en: Make all its utensils of bronze-its pots to remove the ashes, and its shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

27.zh: 要为坛做一个铜网，在网的四角上做四个铜环，
27.en: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.

27.zh: 把网安在坛四面的围腰板以下，使网从下达到坛的半腰。
27.en: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.

27.zh: 又要用皂荚木为坛做杠，用铜包裹。
27.en: Make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.

27.zh: 这杠要穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛。
27.en: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so they will be on two sides of the altar when it is carried.

27.zh: 要用板做坛，坛是空的，都照著在山上指示你的样式作。
27.en: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

27.zh: 你要做帐幕的院子。院子的南面要用撚的细麻做帷子，长一百肘。
27.en: "Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,

27.zh: 帷子的柱子要二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。
27.en: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

27.zh: 北面也当有帷子，长一百肘，帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个。柱子上的钩子和杆子都要用银子做。
27.en: The north side shall also be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

27.zh: 院子的西面当有帷子，宽五十肘，帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个。
27.en: "The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.

27.zh: 院子的东面要宽五十肘。
27.en: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.

27.zh: 门这边的帷子要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。
27.en: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

27.zh: 门那边的帷子也要十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。
27.en: and curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on the other side, with three posts and three bases.

27.zh: 院子的门当有帘子，长二十肘，要拿蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和撚的细麻，用绣花的手工织成，柱子四根，带卯的座四个。
27.en: "For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-the work of an embroiderer-with four posts and four bases.

27.zh: 院子四围一切的柱子都要用银杆连络，柱子上的钩子要用银做，带卯的座要用铜做。
27.en: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.

27.zh: 院子要长一百肘，宽五十肘，高五肘，帷子要用撚的细麻做，带卯的座要用铜做。
27.en: The courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely twisted linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.

27.zh: 帐幕各样用处的器具，并帐幕一切的橛子，和院子里一切的橛子，都要用铜做。
27.en: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.

27.zh: 你要吩咐以色列人，把那为点灯捣成的清橄榄油拿来给你，使灯常常点著。
27.en: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.

27.zh: 在会幕中法柜前的幔外，亚伦和他的儿子，从晚上到早晨，要在耶和华面前经理这灯。这要作以色列人世世代代永远的定例。
27.en: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the curtain that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the Lord from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.

28.zh: 你要从以色列人中，使你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子拿答 、 亚比户 、 以利亚撒 、 以他玛一同就近你，给我供祭司的职分。
28.en: "Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.

28.zh: 你要给你哥哥亚伦做圣衣为荣耀，为华美。
28.en: Make sacred garments for your brother Aaron, to give him dignity and honor.

28.zh: 又要吩咐一切心中有智慧的，就是我用智慧的灵所充满的，给亚伦做衣服，使他分别为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。
28.en: Tell all the skilled men to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.

28.zh: 所要做的就是胸牌 、 以弗得 、 外袍 、 杂色的内袍 、 冠冕 、 腰带，使你哥哥亚伦和他儿子穿这圣服，可以给我供祭司的职分。
28.en: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.

28.zh: 要用金线和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并细麻去做。
28.en: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

28.zh: 他们要拿金线和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻，用巧匠的手工做以弗得。
28.en: "Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen-the work of a skilled craftsman.

28.zh: 以弗得当有两条肩带，接上两头，使他相连。
28.en: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.

28.zh: 其上巧工织的带子，要和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，要用金线和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻做成。
28.en: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it-of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.

28.zh: 要取两块红玛瑙，在上面刻以色列儿子的名字：
28.en: "Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel

28.zh: 六个名字在这块宝石上，六个名字在那块宝石上，都照他们生来的次序。
28.en: in the order of their birth-six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.

28.zh: 要用刻宝石的手工，彷佛刻图书，按著以色列儿子的名字，刻这两块宝石，要镶在金槽上。
28.en: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings

28.zh: 要将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石。亚伦要在两肩上担他们的名字，在耶和华面前作为纪念。
28.en: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the Lord .

28.zh: 要用金子做二槽，
28.en: Make gold filigree settings

28.zh: 又拿精金，用拧工彷佛拧绳子，做两条炼子，把这拧成的炼子搭在二槽上。
28.en: and two braided chains of pure gold, like a rope, and attach the chains to the settings.

28.zh: 你要用巧匠的手工做一个决断的胸牌。要和以弗得一样的做法：用金线和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻做成。
28.en: "Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions-the work of a skilled craftsman. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

28.zh: 这胸牌要四方的，叠为两层，长一虎口，宽一虎口。
28.en: It is to be square-a span long and a span wide-and folded double.

28.zh: 要在上面镶宝石四行：第一行是红宝石 、 红璧玺 、 红玉；
28.en: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz and a beryl;

28.zh: 第二行是绿宝石 、 蓝宝石 、 金钢石；
28.en: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald;

28.zh: 第三行是紫玛瑙 、 白玛瑙 、 紫晶；
28.en: in the third row a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst;

28.zh: 第四行是水苍玉 、 红玛瑙 、 碧玉。这都要镶在金槽中。
28.en: in the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.

28.zh: 这些宝石都要按著以色列十二个儿子的名字，彷佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。
28.en: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

28.zh: 要在胸牌上用精金拧成如绳的炼子。
28.en: "For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

28.zh: 在胸牌上也要做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。
28.en: Make two gold rings for it and fasten them to two corners of the breastpiece.

28.zh: 要把那两条拧成的金炼子，穿过胸牌两头的环子。
28.en: Fasten the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

28.zh: 又要把炼子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。
28.en: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

28.zh: 要做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上。
28.en: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

28.zh: 又要做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
28.en: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

28.zh: 要用蓝细带子把胸牌的环子与以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝。
28.en: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.

28.zh: 亚伦进圣所的时候，要将决断胸牌，就是刻著以色列儿子名字的，带在胸前，在耶和华面前常作纪念。
28.en: "Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the Lord .

28.zh: 又要将乌陵和土明放在决断的胸牌里；亚伦进到耶和华面前的时候，要带在胸前，在耶和华面前常将以色列人的决断牌带在胸前。
28.en: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron's heart whenever he enters the presence of the Lord . Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the Lord .

28.zh: 你要做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
28.en: "Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

28.zh: 袍上要为头留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，彷佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
28.en: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.

28.zh: 袍子周围底边上要用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线做石榴。在袍子周围的石榴中间要有金铃铛：
28.en: Make pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn around the hem of the robe, with gold bells between them.

28.zh: 一个金铃铛一个石榴，一个金铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围的底边上。
28.en: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.

28.zh: 亚伦供职的时候要穿这袍子。他进圣所到耶和华面前，以及出来的时候，袍上的响声必被听见，使他不至于死亡。
28.en: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the Lord and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

28.zh: 你要用精金做一面牌，在上面按刻图书之法刻著归耶和华为圣。
28.en: "Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal:HOLY TO THE Lord .

28.zh: 要用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕的前面。
28.en: Fasten a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban; it is to be on the front of the turban.

28.zh: 这牌必在亚伦的额上，亚伦要担当干犯圣物条例的罪孽；这圣物是以色列人在一切的圣礼物上所分别为圣的。这牌要常在他的额上，使他们可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
28.en: It will be on Aaron's forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron's forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the Lord .

28.zh: 要用杂色细麻线织内袍，用细麻布做冠冕，又用绣花的手工做腰带。
28.en: "Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.

28.zh: 你要为亚伦的儿子做内袍 、 腰带 、 裹头巾，为荣耀，为华美。
28.en: Make tunics, sashes and headbands for Aaron's sons, to give them dignity and honor.

28.zh: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他的儿子穿戴，又要膏他们，将他们分别为圣，好给我供祭司的职分。
28.en: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

28.zh: 要给他们做细麻布裤子，遮掩下体；裤子当从腰达到大腿。
28.en: "Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.

28.zh: 亚伦和他儿子进入会幕，或就近坛，在圣所供职的时候必穿上，免得担罪而死。这要为亚伦和他的后裔作永远的定例。
28.en: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. "This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.

29.zh: 你使亚伦和他儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分，要如此行：取一只公牛犊，两只无残疾的公绵羊，
29.en: "This is what you are to do toconsecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.

29.zh: 无酵饼和调油的无酵饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼；这都要用细麦面做成。
29.en: And from fine wheat flour, without yeast, make bread, and cakes mixed with oil, and wafers spread with oil.

29.zh: 这饼要装在一个筐子里，连筐子带来，又把公牛和两只公绵羊牵来。
29.en: Put them in a basket and present them in it-along with the bull and the two rams.

29.zh: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。
29.en: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

29.zh: 要给亚伦穿上内袍和以弗得的外袍，并以弗得，又带上胸牌，束上以弗得巧工织的带子。
29.en: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.

29.zh: 把冠冕戴在他头上，将圣冠加在冠冕上，
29.en: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred diadem to the turban.

29.zh: 就把膏油倒在他头上膏他。
29.en: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

29.zh: 要叫他的儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。
29.en: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics

29.zh: 给亚伦和他儿子束上腰带，包上裹头巾，他们就凭永远的定例得了祭司的职任。又要将亚伦和他儿子分别为圣。
29.en: and put headbands on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. In this way you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

29.zh: 你要把公牛带到会幕前，亚伦和他儿子要按手在公牛的头上。
29.en: "Bring the bull to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

29.zh: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰这公牛。
29.en: Slaughter it in the Lord 's presence at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

29.zh: 要取些公牛的血，用指头抹在坛的四角上，把血都倒在坛脚那里。
29.en: Take some of the bull's blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

29.zh: 要把一切盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上。
29.en: Then take all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

29.zh: 只是公牛的皮 、 肉 、 粪都要用火烧在营外。这牛是赎罪祭。
29.en: But burn the bull's flesh and its hide and its offal outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

29.zh: 你要牵一只公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在这羊的头上。
29.en: "Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

29.zh: 要宰这羊，把血洒在坛的周围。
29.en: Slaughter it and take the blood and sprinkle it against the altar on all sides.

29.zh: 要把羊切成块子，洗净五脏和腿，连块子带头，都放在一处。
29.en: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the inner parts and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.

29.zh: 要把全羊烧在坛上，是给耶和华献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
29.en: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord , a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the Lord by fire.

29.zh: 你要将那一只公绵羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子要按手在羊的头上。
29.en: "Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

29.zh: 你要宰这羊，取点血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上和他儿子的右耳垂上，又抹在他们右手的大拇指上和右脚的大拇指上；并要把血洒在坛的四围。
29.en: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then sprinkle blood against the altar on all sides.

29.zh: 你要取点膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子和他儿子的衣服上，他们和他们的衣服就一同成圣。
29.en: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.

29.zh: 你要取这羊的脂油和肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油并右腿（这是承接圣职所献的羊）。
29.en: "Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)

29.zh: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼，
29.en: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the Lord , take a loaf, and a cake made with oil, and a wafer.

29.zh: 都放在亚伦的手上和他儿子的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
29.en: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

29.zh: 要从他们手中接过来，烧在耶和华面前坛上的燔祭上，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。
29.en: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the Lord , an offering made to the Lord by fire.

29.zh: 你要取亚伦承接圣职所献公羊的胸，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，这就可以作你的分。
29.en: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron's ordination, wave it before the Lord as a wave offering, and it will be your share.

29.zh: 那摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，就是承接圣职所摇的 、 所举的，是归亚伦和他儿子的。这些你都要成为圣，
29.en: "Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.

29.zh: 作亚伦和他子孙从以色列人中永远所得的分，因为是举祭。这要从以色列人的平安祭中，作为献给耶和华的举祭。
29.en: This is always to be the regular share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the Lord from their fellowship offerings.

29.zh: 亚伦的圣衣要留给他的子孙，可以穿著受膏，又穿著承接圣职。
29.en: "Aaron's sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.

29.zh: 他的子孙接续他当祭司的，每逢进会幕在圣所供职的时候，要穿七天。
29.en: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.

29.zh: 你要将承接圣职所献公羊的肉煮在圣处。
29.en: "Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.

29.zh: 亚伦和他儿子要在会幕门口吃这羊的肉和筐内的饼。
29.en: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

29.zh: 他们吃那些赎罪之物，好承接圣职，使他们成圣；只是外人不可吃，因为这是圣物。
29.en: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.

29.zh: 那承接圣职所献的肉或饼，若有一点留到早晨，就要用火烧了，不可吃这物，因为是圣物。
29.en: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

29.zh: 你要这样照我一切所吩咐的，向亚伦和他儿子行承接圣职的礼七天。
29.en: "Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

29.zh: 每天要献公牛一只为赎罪祭。你洁净坛的时候，坛就洁净了；且要用膏抹坛，使坛成圣。
29.en: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

29.zh: 要洁净坛七天，使坛成圣，坛就成为至圣。凡挨著坛的都成为圣。
29.en: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.

29.zh: 你每天所要献在坛上的就是两只一岁的羊羔；
29.en: "This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.

29.zh: 早晨要献这一只，黄昏的时候要献那一只。
29.en: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.

29.zh: 和这一只羊羔同献的，要用细面伊法十分之一与捣成的油一欣四分之一调和，又用酒一欣四分之一作为奠祭。
29.en: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

29.zh: 那一只羊羔要在黄昏的时候献上，照著早晨的素祭和奠祭的礼办理，作为献给耶和华馨香的火祭。
29.en: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning-a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the Lord by fire.

29.zh: 这要在耶和华面前 、 会幕门口，作你们世世代代常献的燔祭。我要在那里与你们相会，和你们说话。
29.en: "For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the Lord . There I will meet you and speak to you;

29.zh: 我要在那里与以色列人相会，会幕就要因我的荣耀成为圣。
29.en: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.

29.zh: 我要使会幕和坛成圣，也要使亚伦和他的儿子成圣，给我供祭司的职分。
29.en: "So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.

29.zh: 我要住在以色列人中间，作他们的神。
29.en: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

29.zh: 他们必知道我是耶和华 ─ 他们的神，是将他们从埃及地领出来的，为要住在他们中间。我是耶和华 ─ 他们的神。
29.en: They will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.

30.zh: 你要用皂荚木做一座烧香的坛。
30.en: "Make an altar of acacia wood forburning incense.

30.zh: 这坛要四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘；坛的四角要与坛接连一块。
30.en: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high -its horns of one piece with it.

30.zh: 要用精金把坛的上面与坛的四围，并坛的四角，包裹；又要在坛的四围镶上金牙边。
30.en: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

30.zh: 要做两个金环安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁，两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。
30.en: Make two gold rings for the altar below the molding-two on opposite sides-to hold the poles used to carry it.

30.zh: 要用皂荚木做杠，用金包裹。
30.en: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

30.zh: 要把坛放在法柜前的幔子外，对著法柜上的施恩座，就是我要与你相会的地方。
30.en: Put the altar in front of the curtain that is before the ark of the Testimony-before the atonement cover that is over the Testimony-where I will meet with you.

30.zh: 亚伦在坛上要烧馨香料做的香；每早晨他收拾灯的时候，要烧这香。
30.en: "Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.

30.zh: 黄昏点灯的时候，他要在耶和华面前烧这香，作为世世代代常烧的香。
30.en: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the Lord for the generations to come.

30.zh: 在这坛上不可奉上异样的香，不可献燔祭 、 素祭，也不可浇上奠祭。
30.en: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.

30.zh: 亚伦一年一次要在坛的角上行赎罪之礼。他一年一次要用赎罪祭牲的血在坛上行赎罪之礼，作为世世代代的定例。这坛在耶和华面前为至圣。
30.en: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the Lord ."

30.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
30.en: Then the Lord said to Moses,

30.zh: 你要按以色列人被数的，计算总数，你数的时候，他们各人要为自己的生命把赎价奉给耶和华，免得数的时候在他们中间有灾殃。
30.en: "When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the Lord a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.

30.zh: 凡过去归那些被数之人的，每人要按圣所的平，拿银子半舍客勒；这半舍客勒是奉给耶和华的礼物（一舍客勒是二十季拉）。
30.en: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the Lord .

30.zh: 凡过去归那些被数的人，从二十岁以外的，要将这礼物奉给耶和华。
30.en: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the Lord .

30.zh: 他们为赎生命将礼物奉给耶和华，富足的不可多出，贫穷的也不可少出，各人要出半舍客勒。
30.en: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the Lord to atone for your lives.

30.zh: 你要从以色列人收这赎罪银，作为会幕的使用，可以在耶和华面前为以色列人作纪念，赎生命。
30.en: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord , making atonement for your lives."

30.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
30.en: Then the Lord said to Moses,

30.zh: 你要用铜做洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要将盆放在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。
30.en: "Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

30.zh: 亚伦和他的儿子要在这盆里洗手洗脚。
30.en: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.

30.zh: 他们进会幕，或是就近坛前供职给耶和华献火祭的时候，必用水洗濯，免得死亡。
30.en: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water so that they will not die. Also, when they approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made to the Lord by fire,

30.zh: 他们洗手洗脚就免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔世世代代永远的定例。
30.en: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come."

30.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
30.en: Then the Lord said to Moses,

30.zh: 你要取上品的香料，就是流质的没药五百舍客勒，香肉桂一半，就是二百五十舍客勒，菖蒲二百五十舍客勒，
30.en: "Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,

30.zh: 桂皮五百舍客勒，都按著圣所的平，又取橄榄油一欣，
30.en: 500 shekels of cassia-all according to the sanctuary shekel-and a hin of olive oil.

30.zh: 按做香之法调和做成圣膏油。
30.en: Make these into a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer. It will be the sacred anointing oil.

30.zh: 要用这膏油抹会幕和法柜，
30.en: Then use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,

30.zh: 桌子与桌子的一切器具，灯台和灯台的器具，并香坛 、
30.en: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

30.zh: 燔祭坛，和坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座。
30.en: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.

30.zh: 要使这些物成为圣，好成为至圣；凡挨著的都成为圣。
30.en: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.

30.zh: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子，使他们成为圣，可以给我供祭司的职分。
30.en: "Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

30.zh: 你要对以色列人说：这油，我要世世代代以为圣膏油。
30.en: Say to the Israelites, 'This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

30.zh: 不可倒在别人的身上，也不可按这调和之法做与此相似的。这膏油是圣的，你们也要以为圣。
30.en: Do not pour it on men's bodies and do not make any oil with the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.

30.zh: 凡调和与此相似的，或将这膏膏在别人身上的，这人要从民中剪除。
30.en: Whoever makes perfume like it and whoever puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from his people.' "

30.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：你要取馨香的香料，就是拿他弗 、 施喜列 、 喜利比拿；这馨香的香料和净乳香各样要一般大的分量。
30.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Take fragrant spices-gum resin, onycha and galbanum-and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,

30.zh: 你要用这些加上盐，按做香之法做成清净圣洁的香。
30.en: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer. It is to be salted and pure and sacred.

30.zh: 这香要取点捣得极细，放在会幕内 、 法柜前，我要在那里与你相会。你们要以这香为至圣。
30.en: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

30.zh: 你们不可按这调和之法为自己做香；要以这香为圣，归耶和华。
30.en: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the Lord .

30.zh: 凡做香和这香一样，为要闻香味的，这人要从民中剪除。
30.en: Whoever makes any like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from his people."

31.en: Then the Lord said to Moses,

31.zh: 看哪，犹大支派中，户珥的孙子 、 乌利的儿子比撒列，我已经题他的名召他。
31.en: "See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

31.zh: 我也以我的灵充满了他，使他有智慧，有聪明，有知识，能做各样的工，
31.en: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of crafts-

31.zh: 能想出巧工，用金 、 银 、 铜制造各物，
31.en: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

31.zh: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能做各样的工。
31.en: to cut and set stones, to work in wood, and to engage in all kinds of craftsmanship.

31.zh: 我分派但支派中 、 亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯与他同工。凡心里有智慧的，我更使他们有智慧，能做我一切所吩咐的，
31.en: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given skill to all the craftsmen to make everything I have commanded you:

31.zh: 就是会幕和法柜，并其上的施恩座，与会幕中一切的器具，
31.en: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony with the atonement cover on it, and all the other furnishings of the tent-

31.zh: 桌子和桌子的器具，精金的灯台和灯台的一切器具并香坛，
31.en: the table and its articles, the pure gold lampstand and all its accessories, the altar of incense,

31.zh: 燔祭坛和坛的一切器具，并洗濯盆与盆座，
31.en: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, the basin with its stand-

31.zh: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子用以供祭司职分的圣衣，
31.en: and also the woven garments, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests,

31.zh: 膏油和为圣所用馨香的香料。他们都要照我一切所吩咐的去做。
31.en: and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them just as I commanded you."
Then the Lord said to Moses,

31.zh: 你要吩咐以色列人说：你们务要守我的安息日；因为这是你我之间世世代代的证据，使你们知道我 ─ 耶和华是叫你们成为圣的。
31.en: "Say to the Israelites, 'You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the Lord , who makes you holy.

31.zh: 所以你们要守安息日，以为圣日。凡干犯这日的，必要把他治死；凡在这日做工的，必从民中剪除。
31.en: " 'Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from his people.

31.zh: 六日要做工，但第七日是安息圣日，是向耶和华守为圣的。凡在安息日做工的，必要把他治死。
31.en: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord . Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.

31.zh: 故此，以色列人要世世代代守安息日为永远的约。
31.en: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.

31.zh: 这是我和以色列人永远的证据；因为六日之内耶和华造天地，第七日便安息舒畅。
31.en: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he abstained from work and rested.' "

31.zh: 耶和华在西乃山和摩西说完了话，就把两块法版交给他，是神用指头写的石版。
31.en: When the Lord finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

32.zh: 百姓见摩西迟延不下山，就大家聚集到亚伦那里，对他说：起来！为我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了甚么事。
32.en: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, "Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him."

32.zh: 亚伦对他们说：你们去摘下你们妻子 、 儿女耳上的金环，拿来给我。
32.en: Aaron answered them, "Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me."

32.zh: 百姓就都摘下他们耳上的金环，拿来给亚伦。
32.en: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.

32.zh: 亚伦从他们手里接过来，铸了一只牛犊，用雕刻的器具做成。他们就说：以色列阿，这是领你出埃及地的神。
32.en: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, "These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

32.zh: 亚伦看见，就在牛犊面前筑坛，且宣告说：明日要向耶和华守节。
32.en: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar in front of the calf and announced, "Tomorrow there will be a festival to the Lord ."

32.zh: 次日清早，百姓起来献燔祭和平安祭，就坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。
32.en: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.

32.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：下去罢，因为你的百姓，就是你从埃及地领出来的，已经败坏了。
32.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.

32.zh: 他们快快偏离了我所吩咐的道，为自己铸了一只牛犊，向他下拜献祭，说：以色列阿，这就是领你出埃及地的神。
32.en: They have been quick to turn away from what I commanded them and have made themselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. They have bowed down to it and sacrificed to it and have said, 'These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt.'

32.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：我看这百姓真是硬著颈项的百姓。
32.en: "I have seen these people," the Lord said to Moses, "and they are a stiff-necked people.

32.zh: 你且由著我，我要向他们发烈怒，将他们灭绝，使你的后裔成为大国。
32.en: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation."

32.zh: 摩西便恳求耶和华 ─ 他的神说：耶和华阿，你为甚么向你的百姓发烈怒呢？这百姓是你用大力和大能的手从埃及地领出来的。
32.en: But Moses sought the favor of the Lord his God. "O Lord ," he said, "why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?

32.zh: 为甚么使埃及人议论说他领他们出去，是要降祸与他们，把他们杀在山中，将他们从地上除灭？求你转意，不发你的烈怒，后悔，不降祸与你的百姓。
32.en: Why should the Egyptians say, 'It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth'? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.

32.zh: 求你记念你的仆人亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 以色列。你曾指著自己起誓说：我必使你们的后裔像天上的星那样多，并且我所应许的这全地，必给你们的后裔，他们要永远承受为业。
32.en: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: 'I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.' "

32.zh: 于是耶和华后悔，不把所说的祸降与他的百姓。
32.en: Then the Lord relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.

32.zh: 摩西转身下山，手里拿著两块法版。这版是两面写的，这面那面都有字，
32.en: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

32.zh: 是神的工作，字是神写的，刻在版上。
32.en: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

32.zh: 约书亚一听见百姓呼喊的声音，就对摩西说：在营里有争战的声音。
32.en: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is the sound of war in the camp."

32.zh: 摩西说：这不是人打胜仗的声音，也不是人打败仗的声音，我所听见的乃是人歌唱的声音。
32.en: Moses replied: "It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear."

32.zh: 摩西挨近营前就看见牛犊，又看见人跳舞，便发烈怒，把两块版扔在山下摔碎了，
32.en: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.

32.zh: 又将他们所铸的牛犊用火焚烧，磨得粉碎，撒在水面上，叫以色列人喝。
32.en: And he took the calf they had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.

32.zh: 摩西对亚伦说：这百姓向你做了甚么？你竟使他们陷在大罪里！
32.en: He said to Aaron, "What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?"

32.zh: 亚伦说：求我主不要发烈怒。这百姓专于作恶，是你知道的。
32.en: "Do not be angry, my lord," Aaron answered. "You know how prone these people are to evil.

32.zh: 他们对我说：你为我们做神像，可以在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了甚么事。
32.en: They said to me, 'Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him.'

32.zh: 我对他们说：凡有金环的可以摘下来，他们就给了我。我把金环扔在火中，这牛犊便出来了。
32.en: So I told them, 'Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.' Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!"

32.zh: 摩西见百姓放肆（亚伦纵容他们，使他们在仇敌中间被讥刺），
32.en: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.

32.zh: 就站在营门中，说：凡属耶和华的，都要到我这里来！于是利未的子孙都到他那里聚集。
32.en: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, "Whoever is for the Lord , come to me." And all the Levites rallied to him.

32.zh: 他对他们说：耶和华 ─ 以色列的神这样说：你们各人把刀跨在腰间，在营中往来，从这门到那门，各人杀他的弟兄与同伴并邻舍。
32.en: Then he said to them, "This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: 'Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.' "

32.zh: 利未的子孙照摩西的话行了。那一天百姓中被杀的约有三千。
32.en: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.

32.zh: 摩西说：今天你们要自洁，归耶和华为圣，各人攻击他的儿子和弟兄，使耶和华赐福与你们。
32.en: Then Moses said, "You have been set apart to the Lord today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day."

32.zh: 到了第二天，摩西对百姓说：你们犯了大罪。我如今要上耶和华那里去，或者可以为你们赎罪。
32.en: The next day Moses said to the people, "You have committed a great sin. But now I will go up to the Lord ; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin."

32.zh: 摩西回到耶和华那里，说：唉！这百姓犯了大罪，为自己做了金像。
32.en: So Moses went back to the Lord and said, "Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made themselves gods of gold.

32.zh: 倘或你肯赦免他们的罪 … … 不然，求你从你所写的册上涂抹我的名。
32.en: But now, please forgive their sin-but if not, then blot me out of the book you have written."

32.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：谁得罪我，我就从我的册上涂抹谁的名。
32.en: The Lord replied to Moses, "Whoever has sinned against me I will blot out of my book.

32.zh: 现在你去领这百姓，往我所告诉你的地方去，我的使者必在你前面引路；只是到我追讨的日子，我必追讨他们的罪。
32.en: Now go, lead the people to the place I spoke of, and my angel will go before you. However, when the time comes for me to punish, I will punish them for their sin."

32.zh: 耶和华杀百姓的缘故是因他们同亚伦做了牛犊。
32.en: And the Lord struck the people with a plague because of what they did with the calf Aaron had made.

33.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：我曾起誓应许亚伯拉罕 、 以撒 、 雅各说：要将迦南地赐给你的后裔。现在你和你从埃及地所领出来的百姓，要从这里往那地去。
33.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, 'I will give it to your descendants.'

33.zh: 我要差遣使者在你前面，撵出迦南人 、 亚摩利人 、 赫人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人，
33.en: I will send an angel before you and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

33.zh: 领你到那流奶与蜜之地。我自己不同你们上去；因为你们是硬著颈项的百姓，恐怕我在路上把你们灭绝。
33.en: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way."

33.zh: 百姓听见这凶信就悲哀，也没有人佩戴妆饰。
33.en: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.

33.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你告诉以色列人说：耶和华说：你们是硬著颈项的百姓，我若一霎时临到你们中间，必灭绝你们。现在你们要把身上的妆饰摘下来，使我可以知道怎样待你们
33.en: For the Lord had said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites, 'You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.' "

33.zh: 以色列人从住何烈山以后，就把身上的妆饰摘得干净。
33.en: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.

33.zh: 摩西素常将帐棚支搭在营外，离营却远，他称这帐棚为会幕。凡求问耶和华的，就到营外的会幕那里去。
33.en: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the "tent of meeting." Anyone inquiring of the Lord would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.

33.zh: 当摩西出营到会幕去的时候，百姓就都起来，各人站在自己帐棚的门口，望著摩西，直等到他进了会幕。
33.en: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.

33.zh: 摩西进会幕的时候，云柱降下来，立在会幕的门前，耶和华便与摩西说话。
33.en: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the Lord spoke with Moses.

33.zh: 众百姓看见云柱立在会幕门前，就都起来，各人在自己帐棚的门口下拜。
33.en: Whenever the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they all stood and worshiped, each at the entrance to his tent.

33.zh: 耶和华与摩西面对面说话，好像人与朋友说话一般。摩西转到营里去，惟有他的帮手 ─ 一个少年人嫩的儿子约书亚不离开会幕。
33.en: The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.

33.zh: 摩西对耶和华说：你吩咐我说：将这百姓领上去，却没有叫我知道你要打发谁与我同去，只说：我按你的名认识你，你在我眼前也蒙了恩。
33.en: Moses said to the Lord , "You have been telling me, 'Lead these people,' but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, 'I know you by name and you have found favor with me.'

33.zh: 我如今若在你眼前蒙恩，求你将你的道指示我，使我可以认识你，好在你眼前蒙恩。求你想到这民是你的民。
33.en: If you are pleased with me, teach me your ways so I may know you and continue to find favor with you. Remember that this nation is your people."
