33.zh: 耶和华说：我必亲自和你同去，使你得安息。
33.en: The Lord replied, "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."

33.zh: 摩西说：你若不亲自和我同去，就不要把我们从这里领上去。
33.en: Then Moses said to him, "If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.

33.zh: 人在何事上得以知道我和你的百姓在你眼前蒙恩呢？岂不是因你与我们同去 、 使我和你的百姓与地上的万民有分别么？
33.en: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?"

33.zh: 耶和华对摩西说：你这所求的我也要行；因为你在我眼前蒙了恩，并且我按你的名认识你。
33.en: And the Lord said to Moses, "I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name."

33.zh: 摩西说：求你显出你的荣耀给我看。
33.en: Then Moses said, "Now show me your glory."

33.zh: 耶和华说：我要显我一切的恩慈，在你面前经过，宣告我的名。我要恩待谁就恩待谁；要怜悯谁就怜悯谁；
33.en: And the Lord said, "I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the Lord , in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

33.zh: 又说：你不能看见我的面，因为人见我的面不能存活。
33.en: But," he said, "you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live."

33.zh: 耶和华说：看哪，在我这里有地方，你要站在磐石上。
33.en: Then the Lord said, "There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.

33.zh: 我的荣耀经过的时候，我必将你放在磐石穴中，用我的手遮掩你，等我过去，
33.en: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

33.zh: 然后我要将我的手收回，你就得见我的背，却不得见我的面。
33.en: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen."

34.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：你要凿出两块石版，和先前你摔碎的那版一样；其上的字我要写在这版上。
34.en: The Lord said to Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

34.zh: 明日早晨，你要预备好了，上西乃山，在山顶上站在我面前。
34.en: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.

34.zh: 谁也不可和你一同上去，遍山都不可有人，在山根也不可叫羊群牛群吃草。
34.en: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain."

34.zh: 摩西就凿出两块石版，和先前的一样。清晨起来，照耶和华所吩咐的上西乃山去，手里拿著两块石版。
34.en: So Moses chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones and went up Mount Sinai early in the morning, as the Lord had commanded him; and he carried the two stone tablets in his hands.

34.zh: 耶和华在云中降临，和摩西一同站在那里，宣告耶和华的名。
34.en: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the Lord .

34.zh: 耶和华在他面前宣告说：耶和华，耶和华，是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实，
34.en: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, "The Lord , the Lord , the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,

34.zh: 为千万人存留慈爱，赦免罪孽 、 过犯，和罪恶，万不以有罪的为无罪，必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三 、 四代。
34.en: maintaining love to thousands, and forgiving wickedness, rebellion and sin. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children and their children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation."

34.zh: 摩西急忙伏地下拜，
34.en: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.

34.zh: 说：主阿，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你在我们中间同行，因为这是硬著颈项的百姓。又求你赦免我们的罪孽和罪恶，以我们为你的产业。
34.en: "O Lord, if I have found favor in your eyes," he said, "then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance."

34.zh: 耶和华说：我要立约，要在百姓面前行奇妙的事，是在遍地万国中所未曾行的。在你四围的外邦人就要看见耶和华的作为，因我向你所行的是可畏惧的事。
34.en: Then the Lord said: "I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the Lord , will do for you.

34.zh: 我今天所吩咐你的，你要谨守。我要从你面前撵出亚摩利人 、 迦南人 、 赫人 、 比利洗人 、 希未人 、 耶布斯人。
34.en: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

34.zh: 你要谨慎，不可与你所去那地的居民立约，恐怕成为你们中间的网罗；
34.en: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.

34.zh: 却要拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的柱像，砍下他们的木偶。
34.en: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.

34.zh: 不可敬拜别神；因为耶和华是忌邪的神，名为忌邪者。
34.en: Do not worship any other god, for the Lord , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

34.zh: 只怕你与那地的居民立约，百姓随从他们的神，就行邪淫，祭祀他们的神，有人叫你，你便吃他的祭物，
34.en: "Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.

34.zh: 又为你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻，他们的女儿随从他们的神，就行邪淫，使你的儿子也随从他们的神行邪淫。
34.en: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.

34.zh: 不可为自己铸造神像。
34.en: "Do not make cast idols.

34.zh: 你要守除酵节，照我所吩咐你的，在亚笔月内所定的日期吃无酵饼七天，因为你是这亚笔月内出了埃及。
34.en: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt.

34.zh: 凡头生的都是我的；一切牲畜头生的，无论是牛是羊，公的都是我的。
34.en: "The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.

34.zh: 头生的驴要用羊羔代赎，若不代赎就要打折他的颈项。凡头生的儿子都要赎出来。谁也不可空手朝见我。
34.en: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

34.zh: 你六日要做工，第七日要安息，虽在耕种收割的时候也要安息。
34.en: "Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.

34.zh: 在收割初熟麦子的时候要守七七节；又在年底要守收藏节。
34.en: "Celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

34.zh: 你们一切男丁要一年三次朝见主耶和华 ─ 以色列的神。
34.en: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign Lord , the God of Israel.

34.zh: 我要从你面前赶出外邦人，扩张你的境界。你一年三次上去朝见耶和华 ─ 你神的时候，必没有人贪慕你的地土。
34.en: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the Lord your God.

34.zh: 你不可将我祭物的血和有酵的饼一同献上。逾越节的祭物也不可留到早晨。
34.en: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning.

34.zh: 地里首先初熟之物要送到耶和华 ─ 你神的殿。不可用山羊羔母的奶煮山羊羔。
34.en: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk."

34.zh: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：你要将这些话写上，因为我是按这话与你和以色列人立约。
34.en: Then the Lord said to Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

34.zh: 摩西在耶和华那里四十昼夜，也不吃饭也不喝水。耶和华将这约的话，就是十条诫，写在两块版上。
34.en: Moses was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant-the Ten Commandments.

34.zh: 摩西手里拿著两块法版下西乃山的时候，不知道自己的面皮因耶和华和他说话就发了光。
34.en: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the Lord .

34.zh: 亚伦和以色列众人看见摩西的面皮发光就怕挨近他。
34.en: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, his face was radiant, and they were afraid to come near him.

34.zh: 摩西叫他们来；于是亚伦和会众的官长都到他那里去，摩西就与他们说话。
34.en: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.

34.zh: 随后以色列众人都近前来，他就把耶和华在西乃山与他所说的一切话都吩咐他们。
34.en: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.

34.zh: 摩西与他们说完了话就用帕子蒙上脸。
34.en: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.

34.zh: 但摩西进到耶和华面前与他说话就揭去帕子，及至出来的时候便将耶和华所吩咐的告诉以色列人。
34.en: But whenever he entered the Lord 's presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,

34.zh: 以色列人看见摩西的面皮发光。摩西又用帕子蒙上脸，等到他进去与耶和华说话就揭去帕子。
34.en: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the Lord .

35.zh: 摩西招聚以色列全会众，对他们说：这是耶和华所吩咐的话，叫你们照著行：
35.en: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, "These are the things the Lord has commanded you to do:

35.zh: 六日要做工，第七日乃为圣日，当向耶和华守为安息圣日。凡这日之内做工的，必把他治死。
35.en: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of rest to the Lord . Whoever does any work on it must be put to death.

35.zh: 当安息日，不可在你们一切的住处生火。
35.en: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."

35.zh: 摩西对以色列全会众说：耶和华所吩咐的是这样：
35.en: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, "This is what the Lord has commanded:

35.zh: 你们中间要拿礼物献给耶和华，凡乐意献的可以拿耶和华的礼物来，就是金 、 银 、 铜，
35.en: From what you have, take an offering for the Lord . Everyone who is willing is to bring to the Lord an offering of gold, silver and bronze;

35.zh: 蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，
35.en: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

35.zh: 染红的公羊皮，海狗皮，皂荚木，
35.en: ram skins dyed red and hides of sea cows ; acacia wood;

35.zh: 点灯的油，并做膏油和香的香料，
35.en: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

35.zh: 红玛瑙与别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得和胸牌上
35.en: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

35.zh: 你们中间凡心里有智慧的都要来做耶和华一切所吩咐的：
35.en: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the Lord has commanded:

35.zh: 就是帐幕和帐幕的罩棚，并帐幕的盖 、 钩子 、 板 、 闩 、 柱子 、 带卯的座，
35.en: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

35.zh: 柜和柜的杠，施恩座和遮掩柜的幔子，
35.en: the ark with its poles and the atonement cover and the curtain that shields it;

35.zh: 桌子和桌子的杠与桌子的一切器具，并陈设饼，
35.en: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

35.zh: 灯台和灯台的器具，灯盏并点灯的油，
35.en: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;

35.zh: 香坛和坛的杠，膏油和馨香的香料，并帐幕门口的帘子，
35.en: the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil and the fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;

35.zh: 燔祭坛和坛的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
35.en: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the bronze basin with its stand;

35.zh: 院子的帷子和帷子的柱子，带卯的座和院子的门帘，
35.en: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;

35.zh: 帐幕的橛子并院子的橛子，和这两处的绳子，
35.en: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;

35.zh: 精工做的礼服和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。
35.en: the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary-both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests."

35.zh: 以色列全会众从摩西面前退去。
35.en: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses' presence,

35.zh: 凡心里受感和甘心乐意的都拿耶和华的礼物来，用以做会幕和其中一切的使用，又用以做圣衣。
35.en: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved him came and brought an offering to the Lord for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.

35.zh: 凡心里乐意献礼物的，连男带女，各将金器，就是胸前针 、 耳环（或作：鼻环） 、 打印的戒指，和手钏带来献给耶和华。
35.en: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the Lord .

35.zh: 凡有蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，细麻，山羊毛，染红的公羊皮，海狗皮的，都拿了来；
35.en: Everyone who had blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen, or goat hair, ram skins dyed red or hides of sea cows brought them.

35.zh: 凡献银子和铜给耶和华为礼物的都拿了来；凡有皂荚木可做甚么使用的也拿了来。
35.en: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the Lord , and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.

35.zh: 凡心中有智慧的妇女亲手纺线，把所纺的蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和细麻都拿了来。
35.en: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun-blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.

35.zh: 凡有智慧 、 心里受感的妇女就纺山羊毛。
35.en: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.

35.zh: 众官长把红玛瑙和别样的宝石，可以镶嵌在以弗得与胸牌上的，都拿了来；
35.en: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

35.zh: 又拿香料做香，拿油点灯，做膏油。
35.en: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.

35.zh: 以色列人，无论男女，凡甘心乐意献礼物给耶和华的，都将礼物拿来，做耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的一切工。
35.en: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the Lord freewill offerings for all the work the Lord through Moses had commanded them to do.

35.zh: 摩西对以色列人说：犹大支派中，户珥的孙子 、 乌利的儿子比撒列，耶和华已经题他的名召他，
35.en: Then Moses said to the Israelites, "See, the Lord has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

35.zh: 又以神的灵充满了他，使他有智慧 、 聪明 、 知识，能做各样的工，
35.en: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of crafts-

35.zh: 能想出巧工，用金 、 银 、 铜制造各物，
35.en: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

35.zh: 又能刻宝石，可以镶嵌，能雕刻木头，能做各样的巧工。
35.en: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic craftsmanship.

35.zh: 耶和华又使他，和但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯，心里灵明，能教导人。
35.en: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

35.zh: 耶和华使他们的心满有智慧，能做各样的工，无论是雕刻的工，巧匠的工，用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和细麻 、 绣花的工，并机匠的工，他们都能做，也能想出奇巧的工。
35.en: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as craftsmen, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers-all of them master craftsmen and designers.

36.zh: 比撒列和亚何利亚伯，并一切心里有智慧的，就是蒙耶和华赐智慧聪明 、 叫他知道做圣所各样使用之工的，都要照耶和华所吩咐的做工。
36.en: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the Lord has commanded."

36.zh: 凡耶和华赐他心里有智慧 、 而且受感前来做这工的，摩西把他们和比撒列并亚何利亚伯一同召来。
36.en: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the Lord had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.

36.zh: 这些人就从摩西收了以色列人为做圣所并圣所使用之工所拿来的礼物。百姓每早晨还把甘心献的礼物拿来。
36.en: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.

36.zh: 凡做圣所一切工的智慧人各都离开他所作的工，
36.en: So all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work

36.zh: 来对摩西说：百姓为耶和华吩咐使用之工所拿来的，富富有余。
36.en: and said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the Lord commanded to be done."

36.zh: 摩西传命，他们就在全营中宣告说：无论男女，不必再为圣所拿甚么礼物来。这样才拦住百姓不再拿礼物来。
36.en: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: "No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary." And so the people were restrained from bringing more,

36.zh: 因为他们所有的材料够做一切当做的物，而且有余。
36.en: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.

36.zh: 他们中间，凡心里有智慧做工的，用十幅幔子做帐幕。这幔子是比撒列用撚的细麻和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线制造的，并用巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
36.en: All the skilled men among the workmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.

36.zh: 每幅幔子长二十八肘，宽四肘，都是一样的尺寸。
36.en: All the curtains were the same size-twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

36.zh: 他使这五幅幔子幅幅相连，又使那五幅幔子幅幅相连；
36.en: They joined five of the curtains together and did the same with the other five.

36.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做蓝色的钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也照样做；
36.en: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.

36.zh: 在这相连的幔子上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子上也做五十个钮扣，都是两两相对；
36.en: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

36.zh: 又做五十个金钩，使幔子相连。这才成了一个帐幕。
36.en: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.

36.zh: 他用山羊毛织十一幅幔子，作为帐幕以上的罩棚。
36.en: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle-eleven altogether.

36.zh: 每幅幔子长三十肘，宽四肘；十一幅幔子都是一样的尺寸。
36.en: All eleven curtains were the same size-thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

36.zh: 他把五幅幔子连成一幅，又把六幅幔子连成一幅；
36.en: They joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another set.

36.zh: 在这相连的幔子末幅边上做五十个钮扣，在那相连的幔子末幅边上也做五十个钮扣；
36.en: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

36.zh: 又做五十个铜钩，使罩棚连成一个；
36.en: They made fifty bronze clasps to fasten the tent together as a unit.

36.zh: 并用染红的公羊皮做罩棚的盖，再用海狗皮做一层罩棚上的顶盖。
36.en: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of hides of sea cows.

36.zh: 他用皂荚木做帐幕的竖板。
36.en: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

36.zh: 每块长十肘，宽一肘半；
36.en: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

36.zh: 每块有两榫相对。帐幕一切的板都是这样做。
36.en: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

36.zh: 帐幕的南面做板二十块。
36.en: They made twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle

36.zh: 在这二十块板底下又做四十个带卯的银座：两卯接这块板上的两榫，两卯接那块板上的两榫。
36.en: and made forty silver bases to go under them-two bases for each frame, one under each projection.

36.zh: 帐幕的第二面，就是北面，也做板二十块
36.en: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames

36.zh: 和带卯的银座四十个：这板底下有两卯，那板底下也有两卯。
36.en: and forty silver bases-two under each frame.

36.zh: 帐幕的后面，就是西面，做板六块。
36.en: They made six frames for the far end, that is, the west end of the tabernacle,

36.zh: 帐幕后面的拐角做板两块。
36.en: and two frames were made for the corners of the tabernacle at the far end.

36.zh: 板的下半截是双的，上半截是整的，直到第一个环子；在帐幕的两个拐角上都是这样做。
36.en: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.

36.zh: 有八块板和十六个带卯的银座，每块板底下有两卯。
36.en: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases-two under each frame.

36.zh: 他用皂荚木做闩：为帐幕这面的板做五闩，
36.en: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

36.zh: 为帐幕那面的板做五闩，又为帐幕后面的板做五闩，
36.en: five for those on the other side, and five for the frames on the west, at the far end of the tabernacle.

36.zh: 使板腰间的中闩从这一头通到那一头。
36.en: They made the center crossbar so that it extended from end to end at the middle of the frames.

36.zh: 用金子将板包裹，又做板上的金环套闩；闩也用金子包裹。
36.en: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.

36.zh: 他用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和撚的细麻织幔子，以巧匠的手工绣上基路伯。
36.en: They made the curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled craftsman.

36.zh: 为幔子做四根皂荚木柱子，用金包裹，柱子上有金钩，又为柱子铸了四个带卯的银座。
36.en: They made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold. They made gold hooks for them and cast their four silver bases.

36.zh: 拿蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和撚的细麻，用绣花的手工织帐幕的门帘；
36.en: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-the work of an embroiderer;

36.zh: 又为帘子做五根柱子和柱子上的钩子，用金子把柱顶和柱子上的杆子包裹。柱子有五个带卯的座，是铜的。
36.en: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.

37.zh: 比撒列用皂荚木做柜，长二肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘半。
37.en: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood-two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

37.zh: 里外包上精金，四围镶上金牙边，
37.en: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

37.zh: 又铸四个金环，安在柜的四脚上：这边两环，那边两环。
37.en: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

37.zh: 用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹。
37.en: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

37.zh: 把杠穿在柜旁的环内，以便抬柜。
37.en: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

37.zh: 用精金做施恩座，长二肘半，宽一肘半。
37.en: He made the atonement cover of pure gold- two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

37.zh: 用金子锤出两个基路伯来，安在施恩座的两头，
37.en: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

37.zh: 这头做一个基路伯，那头做一个基路伯，二基路伯接连一块，在施恩座的两头。
37.en: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.

37.zh: 二基路伯高张翅膀，遮掩施恩座；基路伯是脸对脸，朝著施恩座。
37.en: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the cover with them. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the cover.

37.zh: 他用皂荚木做一张桌子，长二肘，宽一肘，高一肘半，
37.en: They made the table of acacia wood-two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

37.zh: 又包上精金，四围镶上金牙边。
37.en: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

37.zh: 桌子的四围各做一掌宽的横梁，横梁上镶著金牙边，
37.en: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

37.zh: 又铸了四个金环，安在桌子四脚的四角上。
37.en: They cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners, where the four legs were.

37.zh: 安环子的地方是挨近横梁，可以穿杠抬桌子。
37.en: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.

37.zh: 他用皂荚木做两根杠，用金包裹，以便抬桌子；
37.en: The poles for carrying the table were made of acacia wood and were overlaid with gold.

37.zh: 又用精金做桌子上的器皿，就是盘子 、 调羹，并奠酒的瓶和爵。
37.en: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table-its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.

37.zh: 他用精金做一个灯台；这灯台的座和干，与杯 、 球 、 花，都是接连一块锤出来的。
37.en: They made the lampstand of pure gold and hammered it out, base and shaft; its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms were of one piece with it.

37.zh: 灯台两旁杈出六个枝子：这旁三个，那旁三个。
37.en: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand-three on one side and three on the other.

37.zh: 这旁每枝上有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花；那旁每枝上也有三个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花。从灯台杈出来的六个枝子都是如此。
37.en: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

37.zh: 灯台上有四个杯，形状像杏花，有球有花。
37.en: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

37.zh: 灯台每两个枝子以下有球，与枝子接连一块；灯台杈出的六个枝子都是如此。
37.en: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair-six branches in all.

37.zh: 球和枝子是接连一块，都是一块精金锤出来的。
37.en: The buds and the branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

37.zh: 用精金做灯台的七个灯盏，并灯台的蜡剪和蜡花盘。
37.en: They made its seven lamps, as well as its wick trimmers and trays, of pure gold.

37.zh: 他用精金一他连得做灯台和灯台的一切器具。
37.en: They made the lampstand and all its accessories from one talent of pure gold.

37.zh: 他用皂荚木做香坛，是四方的，长一肘，宽一肘，高二肘，坛的四角与坛接连一块；
37.en: They made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high -its horns of one piece with it.

37.zh: 又用精金把坛的上面与坛的四面并坛的四角包裹，又在坛的四围镶上金牙边。
37.en: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

37.zh: 做两个金环，安在牙子边以下，在坛的两旁 、 两根横撑上，作为穿杠的用处，以便抬坛。
37.en: They made two gold rings below the molding-two on opposite sides-to hold the poles used to carry it.

37.zh: 用皂荚木做杠，用金包裹。
37.en: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

37.zh: 又按做香之法做圣膏油和馨香料的净香。
37.en: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense-the work of a perfumer.

38.zh: 他用皂荚木做燔祭坛，是四方的，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，
38.en: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

38.zh: 在坛的四拐角上做四个角，与坛接连一块，用铜把坛包裹。
38.en: They made a horn at each of the four corners, so that the horns and the altar were of one piece, and they overlaid the altar with bronze.

38.zh: 他做坛上的盆 、 铲子 、 盘子 、 肉锸子 、 火鼎；这一切器具都是用铜做的。
38.en: They made all its utensils of bronze-its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks and firepans.

38.zh: 又为坛做一个铜网，安在坛四面的围腰板以下，从下达到坛的半腰。
38.en: They made a grating for the altar, a bronze network, to be under its ledge, halfway up the altar.

38.zh: 为铜网的四角铸四个环子，作为穿杠的用处。
38.en: They cast bronze rings to hold the poles for the four corners of the bronze grating.

38.zh: 用皂荚木做杠，用铜包裹，
38.en: They made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

38.zh: 把杠穿在坛两旁的环子内，用以抬坛，并用板做坛；坛是空的。
38.en: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.

38.zh: 他用铜做洗濯盆和盆座，是用会幕门前伺候的妇人之镜子作的。
38.en: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

38.zh: 他做帐幕的院子。院子的南面用撚的细麻做帷子，宽一百肘。
38.en: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,

38.zh: 帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个；柱子上的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。
38.en: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

38.zh: 北面也有帷子，宽一百肘。帷子的柱子二十根，带卯的铜座二十个；柱子上的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。
38.en: The north side was also a hundred cubits long and had twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

38.zh: 院子的西面有帷子，宽五十肘。帷子的柱子十根，带卯的座十个；柱子的钩子和杆子都是用银子做的。
38.en: The west end was fifty cubits wide and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases, with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

38.zh: 院子的东面，宽五十肘。
38.en: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.

38.zh: 门这边的帷子十五肘，那边也是一样。帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。在门的左右各有帷子十五肘，帷子的柱子三根，带卯的座三个。
38.en: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

38.zh: a
38.en: and curtains fifteen cubits long were on the other side of the entrance to the courtyard, with three posts and three bases.

38.zh: 院子四面的帷子都是用撚的细麻做的。
38.en: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.

38.zh: 柱子带卯的座是铜的，柱子上的钩子和杆子是银的，柱顶是用银子包的。院子一切的柱子都是用银杆连络的。
38.en: The bases for the posts were bronze. The hooks and bands on the posts were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver; so all the posts of the courtyard had silver bands.

38.zh: 院子的门帘是以绣花的手工，用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和撚的细麻织的，宽二十肘，高五肘，与院子的帷子相配。
38.en: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,

38.zh: 帷子的柱子四根，带卯的铜座四个；柱子上的钩子和杆子是银的；柱顶是用银子包的。
38.en: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.

38.zh: 帐幕一切的橛子和院子四围的橛子都是铜的。
38.en: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.

38.zh: 这是法柜的帐幕中利未人所用物件的总数，是照摩西的吩咐，经祭司亚伦的儿子以他玛的手数点的。
38.en: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which were recorded at Moses' command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

38.zh: 凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的都是犹大支派户珥的孙子 、 乌利的儿子比撒列做的。
38.en: (Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything the Lord commanded Moses;

38.zh: 与他同工的有但支派中亚希撒抹的儿子亚何利亚伯；他是雕刻匠，又是巧匠，又能用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，和细麻绣花。
38.en: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan-a craftsman and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)

38.zh: 为圣所一切工作使用所献的金子，按圣所的平，有二十九他连得并七百三十舍客勒。
38.en: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

38.zh: 会中被数的人所出的银子，按圣所的平，有一百他连得并一千七百七十五舍客勒。
38.en: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel-

38.zh: 凡过去归那些被数之人的，从二十岁以外，有六十万零三千五百五十人。按圣所的平，每人出银半舍客勒，就是一比加。
38.en: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.

38.zh: 用那一百他连得银子铸造圣所带卯的座和幔子柱子带卯的座；一百他连得共一百带卯的座，每带卯的座用一他连得。
38.en: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain-100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.

38.zh: 用那一千七百七十五舍客勒银子做柱子上的钩子，包裹柱顶并柱子上的杆子。
38.en: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.

38.zh: 所献的铜有七十他连得并二千四百舍客勒。
38.en: The bronze from the wave offering was 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.

38.zh: 用这铜做会幕门带卯的座和铜坛，并坛上的铜网和坛的一切器具，
38.en: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,

38.zh: 并院子四围带卯的座和院门带卯的座，与帐幕一切的橛子和院子四围所有的橛子。
38.en: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and those for its entrance and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and those for the surrounding courtyard.

39.zh: 比撒列用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线做精致的衣服，在圣所用以供职，又为亚伦做圣衣，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 他用金线和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻做以弗得；
39.en: They made the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

39.zh: 把金子锤成薄片，剪出线来，与蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，用巧匠的手工一同绣上。
39.en: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut strands to be worked into the blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen-the work of a skilled craftsman.

39.zh: 又为以弗得做两条相连的肩带，接连在以弗得的两头。
39.en: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached to two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

39.zh: 其上巧工织的带子和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，是用金线和蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻做的，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it-of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 又琢出两块红玛瑙，镶在金槽上，彷佛刻图书，按著以色列儿子的名字雕刻；
39.en: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings and engraved them like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.

39.zh: 将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一样的做法，用金线与蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻做的。
39.en: They fashioned the breastpiece-the work of a skilled craftsman. They made it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

39.zh: 胸牌是四方的，叠为两层；这两层长一虎口，宽一虎口，
39.en: It was square-a span long and a span wide-and folded double.

39.zh: 上面镶著宝石四行：第一行是红宝石 、 红璧玺 、 红玉；
39.en: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. In the first row there was a ruby, a topaz and a beryl;

39.zh: 第二行是绿宝石 、 蓝宝石 、 金钢石；
39.en: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald;

39.zh: 第三行是紫玛瑙 、 白玛瑙 、 紫晶；
39.en: in the third row a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst;

39.zh: 第四行是水苍玉 、 红玛瑙 、 碧玉。这都镶在金槽中。
39.en: in the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.

39.zh: 这些宝石都是按著以色列十二个儿子的名字，彷佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。
39.en: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

39.zh: 在胸牌上，用精金拧成如绳子的炼子。
39.en: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

39.zh: 又做两个金槽和两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。
39.en: They made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the rings to two of the corners of the breastpiece.

39.zh: 把那两条拧成的金炼子穿过胸牌两头的环子，
39.en: They fastened the two gold chains to the rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

39.zh: 又把炼子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。
39.en: and the other ends of the chains to the two settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

39.zh: 做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上，
39.en: They made two gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

39.zh: 又做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。
39.en: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

39.zh: 用一条蓝细带子把胸牌的环子和以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod-as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 他用织工做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。
39.en: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth-the work of a weaver-

39.zh: 袍上留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，彷佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。
39.en: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.

39.zh: 在袍子底边上，用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻做石榴，
39.en: They made pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen around the hem of the robe.

39.zh: 又用精金做铃铛，把铃铛钉在袍子周围底边上的石榴中间：
39.en: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.

39.zh: 一个铃铛一个石榴，一个铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围底边上用以供职，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: The bells and pomegranates alternated around the hem of the robe to be worn for ministering, as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 他用织成的细麻布为亚伦和他的儿子做内袍，
39.en: For Aaron and his sons, they made tunics of fine linen-the work of a weaver-

39.zh: 并用细麻布做冠冕和华美的裹头巾，用撚的细麻布做裤子，
39.en: and the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands and the undergarments of finely twisted linen.

39.zh: 又用蓝色 、 紫色 、 朱红色线，并撚的细麻，以绣花的手工做腰带，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: The sash was of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn-the work of an embroiderer-as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 他用精金做圣冠上的牌，在上面按刻图书之法，刻著归耶和华为圣。
39.en: They made the plate, the sacred diadem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE Lord .

39.zh: 又用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
39.en: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 帐幕，就是会幕，一切的工就这样做完了。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样作了。
39.en: So all the work on the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.

39.zh: 他们送到摩西那里。帐幕和帐幕的一切器具，就是钩子 、 板 、 闩 、 柱子 、 带卯的座，
39.en: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

39.zh: 染红公羊皮的盖 、 海狗皮的顶盖，和遮掩柜的幔子，
39.en: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of hides of sea cows and the shielding curtain;

39.zh: 法柜和柜的杠并施恩座，
39.en: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the atonement cover;

39.zh: 桌子和桌子的一切器具并陈设饼，
39.en: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

39.zh: 精金的灯台和摆列的灯盏，与灯台的一切器具，并点灯的油，
39.en: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the oil for the light;

39.zh: 金坛 、 膏油 、 馨香的香料 、 会幕的门帘，
39.en: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

39.zh: 铜坛和坛上的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，
39.en: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

39.zh: 院子的帷子和柱子，并带卯的座，院子的门帘 、 绳子 、 橛子，并帐幕和会幕中一切使用的器具，
39.en: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

39.zh: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。
39.en: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.

39.zh: 这一切工作都是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐摩西做的。
39.en: The Israelites had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

39.zh: 耶和华怎样吩咐的，他们就怎样做了。摩西看见一切的工都做成了，就给他们祝福。
39.en: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

40.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
40.en: Then the Lord said to Moses:

40.zh: 正月初一日，你要立起帐幕，
40.en: "Set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the first month.

40.zh: 把法柜安放在里面，用幔子将柜遮掩。
40.en: Place the ark of the Testimony in it and shield the ark with the curtain.

40.zh: 把桌子搬进去，摆设上面的物。把灯台搬进去，点其上的灯。
40.en: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

40.zh: 把烧香的金坛安在法柜前，挂上帐幕的门帘。
40.en: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

40.zh: 把燔祭坛安在帐幕门前。
40.en: "Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

40.zh: 把洗濯盆安在会幕和坛的中间，在盆里盛水。
40.en: place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it.

40.zh: 又在四围立院帷，把院子的门帘挂上。
40.en: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.

40.zh: 用膏油把帐幕和其中所有的都抹上，使帐幕和一切器具成圣，就都成圣。
40.en: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.

40.zh: 又要抹燔祭坛和一切器具，使坛成圣，就都成为至圣。
40.en: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.

40.zh: 要抹洗濯盆和盆座，使盆成圣。
40.en: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.

40.zh: 要使亚伦和他儿子到会幕门口来，用水洗身。
40.en: "Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

40.zh: 要给亚伦穿上圣衣，又膏他，使他成圣，可以给我供祭司的职分；
40.en: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.

40.zh: 又要使他儿子来，给他们穿上内袍。
40.en: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.

40.zh: 怎样膏他们的父亲，也要照样膏他们，使他们给我供祭司的职分。他们世世代代凡受膏的，就永远当祭司的职任。
40.en: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue for all generations to come."

40.zh: 摩西这样行，都是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: Moses did everything just as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 第二年正月初一日，帐幕就立起来。
40.en: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.

40.zh: 摩西立起帐幕，安上带卯的座，立上板，穿上闩，立起柱子。
40.en: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.

40.zh: 在帐幕以上搭罩棚，把罩棚的顶盖盖在其上，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 又把法版放在柜里，把杠穿在柜的两旁，把施恩座安在柜上。
40.en: He took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.

40.zh: 把柜抬进帐幕，挂上遮掩柜的幔子，把法柜遮掩了，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the Testimony, as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 又把桌子安在会幕内，在帐幕北边，在幔子外。
40.en: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain

40.zh: 在桌子上将饼陈设在耶和华面前，是照耶和华所吩咐他的
40.en: and set out the bread on it before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 又把灯台安在会幕内，在帐幕南边，与桌子相对，
40.en: He placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle

40.zh: 在耶和华面前点灯，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: and set up the lamps before the Lord , as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 把金坛安在会幕内的幔子前，
40.en: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting in front of the curtain

40.zh: 在坛上烧了馨香料做的香，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: and burned fragrant incense on it, as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 又挂上帐幕的门帘。
40.en: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

40.zh: 在会幕的帐幕门前，安设燔祭坛，把燔祭和素祭献在其上，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the Lord commanded him.

40.zh: 把洗濯盆安在会幕和坛的中间，盆中盛水，以便洗濯。
40.en: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,

40.zh: 摩西和亚伦并亚伦的儿子在这盆里洗手洗脚。
40.en: and Moses and Aaron and his sons used it to wash their hands and feet.

40.zh: 他们进会幕或就近坛的时候，便都洗濯，是照耶和华所吩咐他的。
40.en: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, as the Lord commanded Moses.

40.zh: 在帐幕和坛的四围立了院帷，把院子的门帘挂上。这样，摩西就完了工。
40.en: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work. The Glory of the Lord

40.zh: 当时，云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣光就充满了帐幕。
40.en: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

40.zh: 摩西不能进会幕；因为云彩停在其上，并且耶和华的荣光充满了帐幕。
40.en: Moses could not enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled upon it, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

40.zh: 每逢云彩从帐幕收上去，以色列人就起程前往；
40.en: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;

40.zh: 云彩若不收上去，他们就不起程，直等到云彩收上去。
40.en: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out-until the day it lifted.

40.zh: 日间，耶和华的云彩是在帐幕以上；夜间，云中有火，在以色列全家的眼前。在他们所行的路上都是这样。
